# Phone UI Delta Inventory — baseline `d9606460` → `main` `dd5551ec`

**Produced:** 2026-08-26
**Effort:** Demo↔Phone UI Parity v2
**Phone repo (read-only spec source):** `extraction_case_notes_react_native_expo`, branch `main` @ `dd5551ec`
**Baseline:** `d9606460` (2026-07-30) — the commit the v1 screen/logic parity effort was built against
**Demo repo (target):** `demo-website-dvr-extraction-notes` — Next.js, **dark theme only**

---

## 0 Method and confidence

### 0.1 What this document is

Between 2026-07-30 and 2026-08-01 the demo reached full screen and LOGIC parity with the phone
(`docs/planning/demo-phone-parity/00-surface-parity-matrix.md`, 94 deduped rows over the phone's
118 documented surface occurrences). Since then the phone ran three consecutive styling efforts and
the demo received none of them:

| Effort | PRs | Merged | What it was |
|---|---|---|---|
| UI-consistency campaign | #110–#124, phases P0–P13 | 2026-08-21/22 | A 336-finding audit, then 14 merged PRs: a formalized token layer, 8 card families collapsed into one, every off-system colour purged. |
| Post-campaign UI triage | #125 | 2026-08-22/23 | Device-pass touch-ups on what the campaign left rough. |
| Map-chrome redesign + UI touch-ups | #127 (merge `b2f8e65e`), plus `a9451287`, `dd5551ec` | 2026-08-24 | The map view's floating chrome rebuilt, a new filters sheet, splash/drawer/header touch-ups. |

**Logic did not change materially.** This is a styling, token and recipe overhaul. That is what this
document inventories, at a level of detail that lets a matrix-writer map every change onto a demo
surface **without re-opening the phone repo**.

### 0.3 Standing rules this document was written under

- **Current phone source beats every doc.** `docs/ui-mapping/` dates from 2026-07-16, which is
  PRE-campaign; it is used here for surface naming and IDs only. **No style value in this document
  comes from it.** The remediation plan was likewise annotated mid-campaign and carries rows marked
  "⚠ MEASURED WRONG"; the implementation reports and the source are authoritative over it.
- **A citation is a claim.** Every `file:line` in this document was opened at `main`. Where a plan
  or report line number no longer matched, reality was cited and the disagreement noted.
- **Where docs and code disagree, code wins**, and the disagreement is recorded (see §0.6).
- The phone repo was never modified: no edit, no commit, no stash, no checkout, no install.

### 0.4 The prettier trap

Commit `d1739700 style: adopt prettier` reformatted essentially the whole repo inside this range.
A file with a 400-line diffstat is very often a file where **nothing rendered changed**. Every file
in §2 and §3 therefore carries an explicit verdict — `CHANGED` / `UNCHANGED (formatting only)` /
`NEW` — decided by reading the diff past whitespace, quote and trailing-comma churn, not by the
diffstat. A whitespace-insensitive hash comparison over the 85 surface source files found only 5
that are *purely* re-wrapped; the rest needed a human read, which is why the verdict column exists.
**Trust the verdict, not the diffstat.**

### 0.5 Confidence

| Section | Confidence | Basis |
|---|---|---|
| §1 Token layer | **High** | Both revisions of all four constants files read whole and diffed by hand; every value re-grepped at `main`. |
| §1.8 ds-bundle / .design-sync | **High** | Files read whole; the staleness finding was verified by diffing sample values against `Colors.ts`. |
| §1.9 Phase / PR attribution | **Medium-High** | From the implementation reports and `git log`. Phase→PR order is NOT sequential (P12=#111, P11=#113, P1=#118); mis-attribution of a single commit is possible where a phase touched a file another phase also touched. |
| §2 Recipes | **High** | Every recipe copied verbatim from the file at `main` with a line cite. |
| §3 Per-surface | **High** for the changed/unchanged verdict and the file mapping; **Medium** for the one-line "what changed" summaries, which compress §2. Read §2 before porting anything. |
| §4 New/removed | **High** | Existence checked against `git ls-tree d9606460`. |
| §5 Rulings / deferrals | **High** for the ledger text; **Medium** for the "constrains the port" verdicts, which are judgement. |
| §6 Out of scope | **Medium** | Judgement about what a web port cannot or should not follow. |
| §7 Contrast | **High** for the pinned assertions in `palette-contrast.test.ts`; **Medium** for report-recorded figures, most of which are **computed, not observed** — see the warning at the head of §7. |

### 0.6 Could not verify / must be inferred

1. **The consolidated device pass never ran.** The campaign runbook §7 lists it as the top
   outstanding owner item. Only PR #125's `DEVICE-PASS.md` observed anything on hardware. Every
   other ratio in §7 is computed from the token values, not measured on a screen.
2. **`.design-sync/tokens.css` is stale** and must not be used as the port's token source. It was
   generated 2026-07-16 and committed 2026-08-23 without regeneration; its dark half matches the
   palette **at baseline `d9606460`**, i.e. exactly the state the demo already has. Full drift
   analysis in §1.8. Use `src/constants/Colors.ts` at `main`.
3. **`src/constants/README.md`** still documents the pre-recolor palette (`#0d1b2a`, grid at 0.08,
   glass `rgba(19,34,54,0.85)`) — and that file is what `ds-bundle/guidelines/` ships to a design
   agent. Do not mine it.
4. **Two owner rulings were superseded by later code** and the rulings doc was never updated:
   PR #127 `1740f226` supersedes **D3(a)** (the whole map view now follows the app theme rather than
   the floating chrome staying always-dark), and `7df5148b` reverses **D1(a)**'s 4px-accent
   mechanism. §5.1 flags both. Follow the code.
5. **The demo's drift guard is looking for a name that no longer exists.** It searches for
   `Button PRIMARY_GRADIENT.dark`; the export is now `PrimaryButtonGradient` in
   `src/constants/Colors.ts:471`. See §1.4 and §1.8.
6. **`expo prebuild` for ruling D5(a) is still outstanding** on the phone, so the native splash
   colour change is committed but not yet in a built client. Irrelevant to the web port except that
   the JS-side value is what matters.
7. **Post-#127 map pill opacities (0.82 / 0.92) carry no recorded re-measurement.** DEF-062 was
   closed as *accepted*, not re-measured.
8. The **tab bar height is never set** in `app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx` at either revision — it is the
   react-navigation default plus safe-area inset plus `paddingTop: 6`. The demo's fixed
   `TAB_BAR_HEIGHT = 50` therefore has no phone-side number to match against.

## 1 Token layer delta

Four files carry the phone's token layer: `src/constants/Colors.ts`, `Layout.ts`, `Typography.ts`,
`index.ts`. Three of them changed. This section gives every token added, renamed, removed or
value-changed, with the OLD value at `d9606460`, the NEW value at `main`, the `file:line` at `main`,
the phase/PR that introduced it, and the ruling behind it.

**The demo is dark-only.** The `Dark?` column marks whether a row affects a dark-theme render. A
light-only row is recorded for completeness and can be skipped by the port. Every row in §1.2 and
§1.3's dark half is dark-relevant by definition.

`git diff --stat d9606460..main -- src/constants`:

```
 src/constants/Colors.ts                          | 415 +++++++++++++++++---
 src/constants/FormOptions.ts                     |  10 +-      (prettier only)
 src/constants/Layout.ts                          | 108 +++++-
 src/constants/README.md                          |  73 ++--    (stale, see §0.6)
 src/constants/__tests__/palette-contrast.test.ts | 464 +++++++++++++++++++++++  (NEW)
```

`Typography.ts` does not appear: it is **byte-identical** to baseline.

**Unchanged in dark** — and worth stating, because a port that "refreshes everything" will break
them: `primary` `#2B8CC1`, `primaryLight` `#4BA3D4`, `primaryDark` `#1F6B99`, `text` `#f0f4f8`,
`textSecondary` `#99badd`, `textTertiary` `#7a9fc4`, `success` `#10d177`, `successDark` `#0faa5e`,
`error` `#ff4757`, `errorLight` `#b72136`, `errorDark` `#ee2f44`, `warning` `#ffd93d`,
`warningDark` `#ffc62b`, `warningBackground` `#3d3020`, `info` `#99badd`, `infoDark` `#7a9fc4`,
`link` `#b8d4f0`, `linkHover` `#d0e4f7`, `disabledText` `#6b7f95`.

**Three notes the port must carry:**

1. **`scrim` is NOT `overlay` in dark.** Light keeps them at the same value; dark deliberately does
   not. `overlay` stayed at 0.9, `scrim` moved to **0.32**, because 0.9 blacked the app out behind an
   open sheet instead of dimming it. `palette-contrast.test.ts` pins the alpha. Do not "resync" them
   (`Colors.ts:218-231`).
2. **The `*Light` names invert between schemes.** In light they are a pale background tone; in dark
   they are the *dark* background tone the matching `*OnLight` foreground sits on (`Colors.ts:162-164`).
   Every consumer gets this wrong once.
3. **All four dark `*OnLight` foregrounds resolve to `#f0f4f8`.** Dark carries status in the fill and
   the border, not in the text colour (`Colors.ts:186-194`).

### 1.4 New exports from `Colors.ts`

Three named exports that did not exist at baseline. They are the "recipes too specific to be a
colour, too shared to be private" tier.

#### `PrimaryButtonGradient` — `Colors.ts:471-474` — **the Button gradient**

```ts
export const PrimaryButtonGradient = {
  light: ['#2563eb', '#1d3584'],
  dark: [Colors.dark.primaryDark, '#17527A'],   // resolves to ['#1F6B99', '#17527A']
} as const
```

- **Phase/PR:** P9 / #123, corrected in the same PR (the plan's original rows for this are the ones
  marked "⚠ MEASURED WRONG"; the correction block in the plan carries the derivation).
- **What it replaced:** the shipped dark recipe was **`['#35A0D6', '#2580AD']`**, which measured
  **2.94:1** at its worst against white.
- **Measured now, with `onPrimary` `#ffffff`:** dark `#1F6B99` → **5.80:1**, `#17527A` → **8.32:1**;
  light `#2563eb` → **5.17:1**, `#1d3584` → **11.08:1** (`Colors.ts:458-461`).
- **Do not** lighten either dark stop, and **do not** "tokenise" the light pair to
  `[primaryLight, primaryDark]` — that takes a passing 5.17 down to 3.68. On a blue gradient the two
  candidate label colours move in opposite directions, so the label is fixed first and the gradient
  tuned to it (`Colors.ts:463-467`).
- **Consumers:** exactly one — `src/components/common/Button.tsx:281` (imported at `:16`, used in
  the primary variant).
- **⚠ The demo's drift guard.** The guard looks for `Button PRIMARY_GRADIENT.dark`. **That name does
  not exist and never did at `main`.** It is `PrimaryButtonGradient` in `src/constants/Colors.ts`,
  not a `PRIMARY_GRADIENT` const inside `Button.tsx`. Point the guard at
  `Colors.ts:471` → `dark` → `['#1F6B99', '#17527A']`.
- **⚠ Doc-vs-code disagreement.** The docblock at `Colors.ts:451-453` claims two consumers,
  "`Button`'s primary variant and `GpsCaptureControl`". **False at `main`:**
  `GpsCaptureControl.tsx:25` imports only `ElevatedEdges` and `GlassColors`, and paints
  `GlassColors[scheme].elevated`. A repo-wide grep finds one consumer. The comment is stale
  (Phase 9 deviation D8).

#### `ElevatedEdges` — `Colors.ts:487-490`

```ts
export const ElevatedEdges = {
  light: { top: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35)', bottom: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)' },
  dark:  { top: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14)', bottom: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)' },
} as const
```

The lit-top / grounded-bottom edge pair that turns a flat gradient into a raised pressable surface.
Replaced two near-identical private copies (`Button` at 0.14/0.30, `GpsCaptureControl` at 0.16/0.35).
Deliberately white and black rather than theme tokens: these are specular highlight and cast shadow,
not palette colours. **Consumers:** `Button.tsx`, `GpsCaptureControl.tsx:117-118`.

#### `DangerFill` — `Colors.ts:510-513`

```ts
export const DangerFill = {
  light: Colors.light.errorDark,   // '#dc2626'
  dark:  Colors.dark.errorLight,   // '#b72136'
} as const
```

A lookup rather than a per-theme literal **because the `*Light` / `*Dark` names invert between
schemes** (§1.2 note 2). Measured with `onError` `#ffffff`: flat `error` (what these sites shipped)
3.34 dark / 3.76 light FAIL; `errorDark` in both 4.10 dark / 4.83 light (dark fails); **this pair
6.39 dark / 4.83 light PASS** (`Colors.ts:501-506`). **Consumers:** `Button`'s danger variant and
`SwipeDeleteAction`, the confirmation-free destructive affordance DEF-UI-001 attached a named
re-measurement to.

A nested **card** stays at `lg`. `Card`'s glass branch hardcodes `borderRadius.lg` on its container,

**not** want `dialog` — read at source they are a panel, a button glow, a 3D-glass edge and a
recessed well cast.

### 1.8 The formalized token layer: `ds-bundle` and `.design-sync`

Both directories are **new since the baseline `d9606460`**. Together they are the phone repo's one attempt at a machine-readable, cross-platform export of its design tokens, built for Claude Design (claude.ai/design) rather than for this web port. That is worth knowing before trusting anything in them.

#### What `.design-sync/` is

The **source side** of the sync. Six tracked files:

| File | Lines | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `config.json` | 9 | The sync manifest. `projectId 1f62bebe-b5f4-4c7d-a535-921ae3d86d25`, `globalName "DVRExtractionNotes"`, `shape "package"`, `cssEntry ".design-sync/tokens.css"`, `guidelinesGlob ["src/constants/README.md"]`, `readmeHeader ".design-sync/conventions.md"`. |
| `tokens-entry.js` | 15 | An **intentionally empty** ES module (`export {}`). A zero-component entry plus `cfg.cssEntry` is what makes the converter return `tokensOnly: true` instead of exiting on `[ZERO_MATCH]`. The `[ZERO_MATCH] … treating as tokens-only DS` line on every build is expected, not a failure. |
| `gen-tokens.mjs` | 175 | **The token compiler.** See below. |
| `tokens.css` | 286 | The generated CSS custom-property export. **233 `--` declarations.** Reproduced in full in §1.Y.5. |
| `conventions.md` | 86 | The header prepended to the published README: the design agent's house style guide. |
| `NOTES.md` | 115 | The engineering log: how the build works, gotchas found the hard way, and a "Re-sync risks, what can silently go stale" section that predicted exactly the failure this fragment documents. |

Untracked / gitignored: `.cache/`, `node_modules` (a symlink to `../.ds-sync/node_modules`), `previews/`.

**Why tokens-only.** `NOTES.md` records the decision, made with the user on 2026-07-16: this is a React Native Expo app. Its components are RN primitives (`View` / `TouchableOpacity` / `StyleSheet`) plus `expo-linear-gradient` and `expo-haptics`, none of which run in a browser; `main` is `expo-router/entry` and `dist/` is empty and gitignored. **A `react-native-web` port was considered and explicitly rejected**: it would require hand-written browser shims for expo-linear-gradient / expo-haptics / @gorhom/bottom-sheet / reanimated / skia, i.e. authoring a web port that does not exist in the repo, and the shimmed gradients still would not match the device render.

`NOTES.md` then names this repo directly:

> **The separate web port.** The user maintains a full web demo at `../demo-website-dvr-extraction-notes/` (Next.js 15 + React 19 + Tailwind v4, being restyled to a "Case File" design system, already uses Share Tech Mono). That repo, not this one, is where real web components should sync from. **It must be its own Claude Design project**: two repos pinned to one project would delete each other's files on the close-out reconciliation pass. Keep the two projects' tokens in step, **or have the web repo import this repo's generated `tokens.css`.**

That last clause is the sanctioned integration path. §1.Y.4 is why it cannot be taken as-is today.

#### What `ds-bundle/` is

The **output side**, the published artifact, generated by the resync driver rather than hand-written.

```
ds-bundle/
  README.md                        134 lines   = conventions.md + generated token tables
  styles.css                         2 lines   @import "./fonts/fonts.css"; @import "./_ds_bundle.css";
  _ds_bundle.css                  11,815 b     every token in both themes (the scraped tokens.css)
  _ds_bundle.js                    1,152 b     empty-bodied bundle (zero components, by design)
  _ds_sync.json                                styleSha / bundleSha12 / keyRecipe bookkeeping
  _ds_needs_recompile                          {"by":"design-sync-cli"}   <- flag file, PRESENT
  fonts/ShareTechMono-Regular.ttf
  fonts/fonts.css                              rewritten to src: url("./ShareTechMono-Regular.ttf")
  guidelines/index.md
  guidelines/src/constants/README.md  552 lines   a COPY of src/constants/README.md
  components/                      (empty, by design)
  tokens/                          (empty)
  _preview/  _screenshots/         (empty; "render check: 0/0 previews" is expected)
  _vendor/react.js  _vendor/react-dom.js
```

`_ds_needs_recompile` is **present** on disk, which is the CLI's own flag that the bundle is out of date relative to its inputs.

#### How `gen-tokens.mjs` derives the CSS

`.design-sync/gen-tokens.mjs` esbuild-transpiles `src/constants/{Colors,Layout,Typography}.ts` into a temp ESM module, imports it, walks the objects, and writes `tokens.css`. It is deterministic. The RN-to-CSS equivalences it applies are each documented in the header as "a real, checked equivalence":

- **Glass gradients.** RN `LinearGradient start={{x:0,y:0}} end={{x:0,y:1}}` (verified in `Button` / `Card` / `FormSection` / `GlassBottomSheet`) is exactly CSS `linear-gradient(180deg, …)`.
- **Font family.** `Typography.fontFamily`'s `'System'` maps to `system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif`; `'monospace'` to `ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace`; `'ShareTechMono-Regular'` to `"Share Tech Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace`.
- **Numbers.** RN density-independent px are emitted as CSS `px`. `lineHeight`, `fontWeight` and `zIndex` stay unitless.
- **Naming.** camelCase to kebab-case via `s.replace(/([a-z0-9])([A-Z])/g, '$1-$2').toLowerCase()`, so `backgroundSecondary` becomes `--color-background-secondary`, `nestedCard` becomes `--glass-nested-card-*`, `highlightTop` becomes `--glass-*-highlight-top`. The `'2xl'` / `'3xl'` / `'4xl'` keys pass through unchanged.
- **Prefixes.** `--color-*` from `Colors[scheme]`; `--glass-{variant}-{gradient,border,highlight-top,inner-shadow}` from `GlassColors[scheme]`; `--spacing-*`, `--radius-*`, `--touch-target-*`, `--screen-padding-*`, `--icon-size-*`, `--container-*`, `--z-*`, `--drawer-*` from `Layout`; `--font-family-*`, `--font-size-*`, `--line-height-*`, `--font-weight-*`, `--letter-spacing-*` from `Typography`.
- **Theme emission.** Light lands on bare `:root` along with every theme-independent scale. Dark is emitted **twice, byte-identical**: once under `[data-theme="dark"]` (explicit opt-in) and once under `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { :root:not([data-theme="light"]) }`.
- **What it does NOT emit:** `Layout.shadow` (all three tiers, `card` / `dialog` / `sheet`, each with light and dark), `Layout.headerPadding`, and the three loose exports in `Colors.ts`: `PrimaryButtonGradient`, `ElevatedEdges`, `DangerFill`. Those are hand-ports for the web.
- **`@font-face` gotcha, load-bearing:** the `src` url must resolve relative to `.design-sync/tokens.css` (`url("../assets/fonts/ShareTechMono-Regular.ttf")`). A bundle-root-relative url is unresolvable at scrape time. The converter drops the rule *and* copies it out un-rewritten with a broken `fonts/fonts/…` path, producing a **silent** fallback font.

#### The naming convention (`conventions.md`)

86 lines, published as the head of `ds-bundle/README.md`. Its substance:

- **Ships tokens, not components.** "Build your own components, but take every color, space, radius, and type value from the custom properties below. **Do not introduce new palette values.**"
- **Dark-first, light-default.** Light is the `:root` default; dark activates via `<html data-theme="dark">` or `prefers-color-scheme: dark` unless `data-theme="light"` overrides.
- **The idiom is `var(--token)`.** No utility classes, no component library, plain CSS.
- **The glass idiom is the signature surface**, and it is a **gradient, never a blur**, a deliberate decision because blur is too expensive on the low-end Android devices used in field work. Compose all four parts:
  ```css
  .card {
    background: var(--glass-card-gradient);
    border: 1px solid var(--glass-card-border);
    border-top-color: var(--glass-card-highlight-top);  /* lit top edge */
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 var(--glass-card-inner-shadow);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    padding: var(--spacing-md);
  }
  ```
  `card` for standard surfaces, `nested-card` for a card inside a card, `elevated` for modals and popovers, `header` for bars. **"Never use `backdrop-filter: blur()`."**
- **44px floor** on every interactive target, "a WCAG requirement the product holds itself to, not a suggestion".
- **`--font-family-scanner-mono`** (Share Tech Mono, shipped in `fonts/`) is for scanner, terminal and OCR readouts and timestamps, **not body text**.
- **The dark-only-token gotcha**, which is now wrong. See §1.Y.4.
- Token families enumerated as real: Color, Glass (`--glass-{card,nested-card,elevated,header}-{gradient,border,highlight-top,inner-shadow}`), Spacing (`xxs`..`xxl`, 2 to 48px), Radius (`none,sm,md,lg,xl,full`), Touch (`min,medium,comfortable,large` = 44/46/48/56px), Type, Font, Other (`--icon-size-*`, `--container-*`, `--z-*`, `--drawer-width`, `--screen-padding-*`).

#### 1.Y.4 Is `tokens.css` current with `Colors.ts` at `main`? No. It is a full campaign behind.

`tokens.css` was generated **2026-07-16** and merely *committed* on 2026-08-23 (`9b0d43ee`, "chore(design-sync): track the design-token sync config") without being regenerated. The badge-blue recolor landed 2026-08-20 (`68f4e18a`) and the whole UI-consistency campaign after it. Verified by re-deriving the CSS from `src/constants/Colors.ts` at `main` with the generator's own mapping rules and diffing property by property: **the dark half of `tokens.css` matches the palette at the BASELINE `d9606460` exactly**, not `main`.

`NOTES.md` predicted this in its own words: *"`tokens.css` is generated. If someone edits `src/constants/*.ts` and re-syncs WITHOUT running `gen-tokens.mjs`, the upload ships the old palette and nothing flags it."*

**Missing from `tokens.css` (dark), 17:** `--color-grid-subtle`, `--color-warning-accent`, `--color-info-on-light`, `--color-warning-on-light`, `--color-success-on-light`, `--color-error-on-light`, `--color-on-primary`, `--color-on-error`, `--color-scrim`, and the entire `--glass-sheet-*` and `--glass-recessed-*` tiers (four properties each).

**Stale in `tokens.css` (dark), deleted from `Colors.ts` by DEF-UI-010, still exported, 8:** `--color-grid-accent`, `--color-accent`, `--color-accent-light`, `--color-accent-dark`, `--color-blueprint`, `--color-blueprint-dim`, `--color-tech`, `--color-tech-dim`. Their documented equivalences, recorded in `Colors.ts:237-255`: `accent`=`warning`, `blueprint`=`textSecondary`/`info`, `tech`=`link`, `gridAccent`=`border`, `blueprintDim`=`withAlpha(textSecondary, 0.3)`, `techDim`=`withAlpha(link, 0.3)`. Only `accentLight` / `accentDark` were unique and nothing rendered them.

**This makes `conventions.md` and `ds-bundle/README.md` actively wrong.** Both carry a "Gotchas, Dark-only tokens" section instructing the consumer to write `var(--color-accent, var(--color-warning))`. All eight of those tokens no longer exist in the source. `NOTES.md` flagged the risk in advance: *"`conventions.md` enumerates real token names (77 of them, all validated against the build on 2026-07-16). Renaming or removing a token in `src/constants/` makes the header lie, and the design agent will trust it and emit CSS that resolves to nothing."* That has now happened.

**LIGHT: 6 values changed, 19 tokens missing, 0 stale.** `--color-text-secondary` `#6b7280` to **`#4b5563`**; `--color-text-tertiary` `#9ca3af` to **`#6b7280`**; `--color-link` `#3b82f6` to **`#1e40af`**; `--color-link-hover` `#2563eb` to **`#1e3a8a`**; `--glass-nested-card-gradient` `180deg, rgba(241,245,249,0.85), rgba(226,232,240,0.9)` to **`180deg, rgba(233,238,245,1), rgba(223,231,239,1)`**; `--glass-nested-card-border` `rgba(148,163,184,0.35)` to **`rgba(100,116,139,0.45)`**. Missing: the same 17 as dark, plus `--color-grid` and `--color-grid-light` (light had no grid tokens at all before P0).

**`Layout` drift, the generator's scales are also behind.** `tokens.css` has spacing `xxs/xs/sm/md/lg/xl/xxl` (7) against the current 10: **`--spacing-xsm` (6px), `--spacing-base` (12px) and `--spacing-mdlg` (20px) are absent** (ruling M5a). Radius has `none/sm/md/lg/xl/full` (6) against the current 8: **`--radius-control` (10px) and `--radius-sheet` (22px) are absent** (ruling D4a). And `Layout.shadow` (`card` / `dialog` / `sheet`, each with a light and a dark variant) is not emitted by the generator at all, in any version. The current values, for a hand-port:

| Tier | light | dark |
|---|---|---|
| `card` | color `rgba(30,58,138,0.18)`, offset `0 3`, opacity 1, radius 8, elevation 4 | color `#000`, offset `0 4`, opacity 0.15, radius 8, elevation 4 |
| `dialog` | color `rgba(30,58,138,0.15)`, offset `0 8`, opacity 1, radius 28, elevation 24 | color `#000`, offset `0 8`, opacity 0.5, radius 40, elevation 24 |
| `sheet` | color `rgba(30,58,138,0.15)`, offset `0 -8`, opacity 1, radius 28, elevation 24 | color `#000`, offset `0 -8`, opacity 0.5, radius 40, elevation 24 |

**`Typography` is the one clean half.** `src/constants/Typography.ts` is byte-identical between `d9606460` and `main` (`git diff --stat` returns nothing), so every `--font-*`, `--line-height-*` and `--letter-spacing-*` in `tokens.css` is current: sizes `12/14/16/18/20/24/30/36`, line heights `1.25/1.5/1.75`, weights `400/500/600/700`, letter spacing `-0.5/0/0.5px`. Note per `NOTES.md` that all four of `--font-family-{regular,medium,semibold,bold}` collapse to the same system stack, because RN maps them all to `'System'` and carries weight in `fontWeight`. Faithful to the source, surprising to a web consumer.

**The bundled guidelines are stale too, and independently so.** `ds-bundle/guidelines/src/constants/README.md` is a July copy of `src/constants/README.md` and still lists the **Extended Dark Properties** block that the live README deleted (that deletion is part of the 73-line diff on `src/constants/README.md`). But the live `src/constants/README.md` is *itself* wrong on values at `main`: `:107` still says the dark backgrounds are `#0d1b2a` / `#132236` / `#1a2d44`, `:111` still says the grid is `rgba(153, 186, 221, 0.08)`, and `:127` still says the dark glass gradient is `rgba(19,34,54,0.85)` to `rgba(26,45,68,0.92)`. All three are the pre-recolor palette. **Where docs and code disagree, code wins, and here the docs at three levels (bundle copy, live README, generated CSS) all disagree with `src/constants/Colors.ts`.** The live README's own real content changes were textual: "extended dark mode palette" replaced by "identical key sets, so `Colors[colorScheme].<token>` is always safe", and the Extended Dark Properties line deleted.

**Bottom line for the port.** `tokens.css` is the most *directly portable* artifact in the repo in **shape** (the naming convention, the theme-activation pattern, the four-part glass composition, the 180deg gradient equivalence) and the least trustworthy in **value**. Use its structure; take every hex from `src/constants/Colors.ts` at `main`, or regenerate it first with `node .design-sync/gen-tokens.mjs`, which reads `src/` and writes only into `.design-sync/`. Regenerating would also close the eight stale dark-only tokens and add the 17 missing ones, but it would still not emit `Layout.shadow`, `PrimaryButtonGradient`, `ElevatedEdges` or `DangerFill`.

#### The Button gradient

The demo has a drift guard that looks for `Button PRIMARY_GRADIENT.dark` and breaks. **That name no longer exists anywhere in the phone repo.**

- **Old shipped recipe:** a module-private `PRIMARY_GRADIENT` constant inside `src/components/common/Button.tsx`, with `GpsCaptureControl` carrying a hand-maintained second copy (`GPS_GRADIENT_DARK`) that the audit found. The dark pair was **`['#35A0D6', '#2580AD']`**. Painted under `colors.textInverse` (`#002853`) it measured **5.01 / 3.34**, worst **3.34** — a FAIL. The plan's Phase 9 row `:197` proposed swapping the label to `colors.onPrimary` (`#ffffff`), which measures **2.94 / 4.40**, worst **2.94** — *worse*. The plan's row `:17` proposed re-tokenising the gradient to `[colors.primaryLight, colors.primary]` (dark) / `[colors.primaryLight, colors.primaryDark]` (light); the light half takes a **passing 5.17 down to 3.68**. Both rows were annotated `⚠ MEASURED WRONG` in the plan at `01-CONSISTENCY-REMEDIATION-PLAN.md:370` and `:372`, with a binding correction block at `:397-448`.
- **Where it lives now:** `src/constants/Colors.ts:471-474`, hoisted out of the component in Phase 9 / PR #123.
- **Exact export name:** `PrimaryButtonGradient` (PascalCase, a named export, `as const`).
- **Values at `main`:**

  ```ts
  export const PrimaryButtonGradient = {
    light: ['#2563eb', '#1d3584'],
    dark: [Colors.dark.primaryDark, '#17527A'],   // resolves to ['#1F6B99', '#17527A']
  } as const
  ```

  Measured with `onPrimary` (`#ffffff`), top stop then bottom stop: **dark `#1F6B99` 5.80 : 1` and `#17527A` 8.32 : 1`; light `#2563eb` 5.17 : 1` and `#1d3584` 11.08 : 1`.** Both stops of both themes clear AA 4.5:1 for the 16px semibold label. The light pair is **unchanged from what shipped**; it already passed.
- **The docblock's binding constraints** (`Colors.ts:444-470`): it lives outside `GlassColors` because `GlassVariant` is `Card`'s `glassVariant` prop type and a button fill is not a card surface, so `<Card glass glassVariant="primaryButton">` must not become expressible. **Do NOT lighten either dark stop** and **do NOT "tokenise" the light pair to `[primaryLight, primaryDark]`.** On a blue gradient the two candidate label colours move in opposite directions, so the label is fixed first and the gradient tuned to it.
- **Consumers at `main`:** exactly **one** — `src/components/common/Button.tsx:281`, `colors={[...PrimaryButtonGradient[colorScheme]]}` (imported at `:16`). Plus the pin at `src/constants/__tests__/palette-contrast.test.ts:234-237`.
- **DOC-VS-CODE DISAGREEMENT, verified at source.** The docblock at `Colors.ts:451-453` claims *"there are two consumers: `Button`'s primary variant and `GpsCaptureControl`, whose hand-maintained copy of this recipe is what the audit found."* **That is false at `main`.** `src/features/location/components/GpsCaptureControl.tsx:25` imports `{ ElevatedEdges, GlassColors }` and **not** `PrimaryButtonGradient`; at `:110` it paints `GlassColors[colorScheme].elevated`. This is Phase 9's own deviation **D8** (`P9-implementation-report.md:305-313`), added late during PR #123 F8: GPS capture is a secondary action next to the screen's real CTA, and painting it in the primary gradient would give a form two competing primaries. Its label measures 9.60 dark / 16.96 light, so no AA issue results. The plan's correction block also still says "`GpsCaptureControl.tsx:36,105,193` … inherits whichever choice is made here" — it does not. Code wins: **one consumer.**

**Two sibling exports the drift guard should probably also know about**, both added in the same phase and both absent from `tokens.css`:

- `ElevatedEdges` (`Colors.ts:487-490`) — the lit-top / grounded-bottom edge pair that turns a flat gradient into a raised pressable surface. `light: { top: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.35)', bottom: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.1)' }`, `dark: { top: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.14)', bottom: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)' }`. **Deliberately white and black rather than theme tokens**: these are specular highlight and cast shadow, the light source and its absence, not palette colours. Two consumers: `Button.tsx:120-121` and `GpsCaptureControl.tsx:117-118`, which previously carried near-identical drifted copies (0.16/0.35 against Button's 0.14/0.30).
- `DangerFill` (`Colors.ts:510-513`) — `light: Colors.light.errorDark` (`#dc2626`), `dark: Colors.dark.errorLight` (`#b72136`). A lookup rather than a literal per theme **because the `*Light` / `*Dark` names invert between schemes by design**: in dark mode the `*Light` names are the DARK background tone. Measured with `onError` (`#ffffff`): flat `error` **3.34 dark / 3.76 light FAIL**; `errorDark` in both **4.10 / 4.83, dark fails**; this pair **6.39 / 4.83 PASS**. Two consumers: `Button.tsx:61` (danger variant) and `SwipeDeleteAction.tsx:105`.

#### Per-phase deviations from the plan — what a naive plan-reader would get wrong

#### P0 (#112)
1. `ImportResultBody.tsx` and `DashboardCaseCard.tsx` do **not** read `Layout.shadow.card` despite §2.4 naming them; both blocks are deleted outright by later phases. `ImportResultBody`'s shadow was genuinely different from `Card`'s (`shadowOpacity: 0.18` on an already-0.18-alpha light `shadowColor`, so ~5× fainter; dark offset 3 not 4) — **Phase 2 was told to expect a visible change there, not a no-op**.
2. **`Banner` is OPAQUE, not a `nestedCard` gradient** — the plan specified the glass gradient. The `*OnLight` AA guarantee is measured against the `*Light` tone; a translucent gradient composites over an unknown parent and the ratio becomes unmeasurable. *This is the single most portable rule in P0: a severity callout is a semantic surface, not a depth one.*
3. `Banner`'s **icon uses the `*OnLight` foreground, not the accent** — as an icon the saturated accent measures 1.92–2.24:1 in three of the eight severity/scheme combinations.
4. No barrel entry for `Banner` or `withAlpha`.
5. `Typography.ts` was **not touched** at all in P0 (or anywhere in the campaign — it is byte-identical between `d9606460` and `main`).
6. `dark.successLight` / `dark.warningLight` values changed. Not a D8(a) deviation, but it is a change to *existing* token values and was called out as such.

#### P1 (#118)
- **D-1** `LocationRow` and `MapPicker` rows are **local glass compositions, not `<Card glass>`** — the plan implies `Card`.
- **D-2** `PROXIMITY_COLORS` touched despite being on the plan's "Leave alone" list.
- **D-3** `MapControls` pills got `minHeight`, **not** `hitSlop`.
- **D-4** `LocationList`'s Export Map CTA **loses its `map-outline` icon**.
- **D-5** `MapBottomSheet`'s shadow moved to `Layout.shadow.sheet`.
- **D-6** `MapScaleBar`'s dark label **stayed white**. It was briefly moved to `Colors.dark.text`, which measured 3.70:1 over a bright tile against white's 4.05 — commit 7 put it back.
- **D-7** a typography-snapping rule was applied beyond the plan's rows.
- **D-8** two files touched that have no Phase 1 row.
- Also: `MapPicker` was elevated from Phase 4 to Phase 1 by rulings **Addendum 1**; the two Phase 4 rows for it are dead.

#### P2 (#117)
- **D1** `ImportFlowModal:106`'s `ResultHeader` used `GlassColors[scheme].header`, not `<Header glass>`.
- **D2** all four sites to `elevated`; the *nested* warnings card at `:327` to `nestedCard` — the plan said "pick one variant".
- **D3** radius fixes applied beyond the two named rows (`ImportResultBody`'s warnings card and `BatchResultDetails`' failure card moved off `xl`).
- **D4** five arithmetic/raw font sizes fixed, not four.
- **D5** two new files created that are not in the plan: `pdf-import/constants/terminal-palette.ts` and `json-import/constants.ts`.
- **D6** em dashes removed from three `ImportTerminalProgress` strings (standing rule).

#### P3 (#114)
- **D1** `Card` padding on the validation modal went `lg` (24) → default `md` (16).
- **D2** `ExportHub`'s Retry button sits **beside** the `Banner`, not inside it.
- **D3** `ExportActionSheet`'s scrim label **degraded** from "Close export options" to "Close" (no per-caller prop existed) — became DEF-UI-006, restored in P5.
- **D4** em-dash copy fixes in two strings not on the table.
- **D5** `ExportActionSheet` gained `paddingBottom: Layout.spacing.lg`.

#### P4 (#119)
- **D-1** `DashboardCaseCard.tsx:362` took `colors.text`, **not** the plan's `colors.primary` — `primary` is a mid-tone fill and measures **2.81:1** as 10px text.
- **D-2** nested **rows** hand-roll the glass rather than using `<Card>`.
- Round-2 correction on the record: the aggregator's own F119-3 mis-attributed `DashboardCaseCard.personnelName` (it is `colors.text`, 16.98→14.56, nowhere near AA). The finding's substance held; its attribution did not.

#### P5 (#120)
- **D1 WITHDRAWN in round 1** — the implementer originally refused the `MediaLibrarySheet` fold into `GlassBottomSheet`; the refutation was adjudicated and the fold executed.
- **D2** `MediaLibrarySheet:357` close button: no change needed.
- **D3** `MediaPreviewFullscreen:129` was two separate things (hence `MEDIA_CLOSE_CHIP` splitting off later).
- **D4** took Phase 8's `AuthenticatedSplashScreen:308` row (HUD scrim) — **Phase 8's plan row 356 is a no-op**.
- **D5** plan §4's "Phase 5 snapshots" row is **wrong**; a Phase 12 snapshot moved instead.
- **D6** three private `@/context/ThemeContext` test mocks deleted.
- **D7** `PasswordModal` shadow geometry changed.
- **Not verified, still outstanding:** three of D5(a)'s six sites are native (`app.config.js`) and need `npx expo prebuild` + a fresh dev build. On an un-rebuilt client the **old `#000314` native splash hands off to the new `#002853` JS surface** — the exact artifact D5(a) exists to prevent. Still listed as outstanding in PR #125's DEVICE-PASS.

#### P6 (#115)
- **D1** `Banner severity` is `notification.type`, not a hardcoded `"warning"`.
- **D2** the two `borderColor: colors.textSecondary` overrides are **deleted**, not re-pointed to `colors.border`.
- **D3** `time-offset.tsx:548` takes the "documented sub-heading" branch; treatment unchanged (became DEF-UI-012).
- **D4** the `TextInput` disabled foreground is `colors.textSecondary`, **not** `colors.disabledText`.
- **D5/D6** `RouteErrorFallback` API changes (`message` not `fallbackMessage`; `logError` moved behind a required `context` prop).

#### P7 (#116)
- **D-1** the six `#5a7a9a` sites took **`textSecondary`, not the plan's `textTertiary`**, and the size was not raised. Consequence: `TimerCard`'s two metadata tiers collapse to one. Plan's `textTertiary` measured **2.32:1** on the same surface.
- **D-2** `SpectrumVisualizer` and `GlassPillButton` **keep their own hand-rolled gradients** rather than moving to `<Card glass>` — because `Card` could not host `flex: 1` or a pill radius (this is DEF-UI-008).
- **D-3** `CrtOverlay.tsx:19` took `colors.textSecondary` where the plan said `colors.blueprint` — `blueprint` is unreachable through `useTheme()` (DEF-UI-010). Byte-identical `#99badd` in dark.

#### P8 (#122)
- **D-1** four of the plan's "Banner bullet" neutral containers became `nestedCard` surfaces instead.
- **D-2** three severity containers keep their layout and adopt Banner's token **pair** rather than becoming Banners.
- **D-3** `SecuritySettingsSection`'s warning title folds into the Banner message.
- **D-4** the password **input** is not migrated to `<TextInput secureTextEntry>` — the shared eye affordance the plan names **does not exist** (DEF-UI-024).
- **D-5** `AboutSection`'s support row loses `accessibilityRole="link"` (overruled in this branch's favour at review: `"button"` is better for a `mailto:`).
- **D-6** the two pressed/chip rgba rows use `colors.link`/`colors.text`, **not** the plan's `colors.primary`.
- **D-7** `PasswordModal` and `BiometricsUnavailableScreen` primary labels use `colors.textInverse`, **not** `colors.onPrimary` — this is the measurement that produced the binding correction block.
- **D-8** `common/RadioGroup.tsx` (a Phase 9 file) gains a `direction` prop.
- **D-9** `src/components/layout/index.ts` exports only `ModalHeader`.
- **D-10** em dashes removed from copy this phase was already rewriting.

#### P9 (#123)
- **D1** `TextInput.tsx:67` fill swap **REFUSED on measurement**. The plan's `colors.background`→`colors.backgroundSecondary` measures **1.04 / 1.09** against the glass card it would sit inside, versus 1.20 / 1.37 retained. The plan's fix made the dominant case worse.
- **D2** scanner-HUD type and spacing scales **REFUSED**.
- **D3** `Button.tsx:17`'s **light half NOT applied** — the plan's `[primaryLight, primaryDark]` takes a passing 5.17 down to **3.68**.
- **D4** fills moved wherever `onPrimary`/`onError` was applied — the standing rule: *`onPrimary` pairs with the deep shade, never the flat mid-tone.*
- **D5** plan rows **widened** beyond their text at `Card` (whole style set, not two keys).
- **D6** two feature files edited outside the plan's list, on DEF-UI-017's instruction.
- **D7** a `GlassBottomSheet` test assertion **reversed** (the sheet is bottom-anchored in a `flex-end` overlay, so padding grows it *upward*).
- **D8** `GpsCaptureControl` does **NOT** adopt `PrimaryButtonGradient` — it moves to `GlassColors[scheme].elevated` + `ElevatedEdges`, a neutral raised glass tier, because painting a secondary action in the primary gradient gives a form two competing primaries.
- **D9** `GpsCaptureControl`'s border went `StyleSheet.hairlineWidth` → flat `1`.

#### P10 (#121)
- **D-1** divider token differs from the plan's prescribed `rgba(0,0,0,0.1)`/`rgba(0,0,0,0.05)` — those measure **1.24:1 dark / 1.02:1 light** (in light, the surface colour). Shipped recipe measures 1.72 / 1.51.
- **D-2** `common/RadioGroup.tsx:102` (a Phase 9 row) taken early.
- **D-3** `TimeSyncErrorBoundary` also gains glass beyond the padding row.
- **D-4** `CameraControls` button scrim **deepened, not merely tokenized**: the plan's `withAlpha(colors.background, 0.4)` measures 2.17:1 for the icon over a bright DVR monitor — *worse* than the 2.85 it replaces. Shipped `colors.overlay` (90%) at 10.04.
- **D-5** `CaptureButton` gains accessibility props it never had.
- **Two plan claims REFUTED at source and upheld in review:** (R-1) "`ProfilePicker` → `<RadioGroup>` fixes the 1.73:1 chip boundary" — **it does not**, it is unchanged at 1.73 dark / 1.24 light. (R-2) "outline-only group → `nestedCard` fixes the 1.73:1 sole boundary" — structurally yes, numerically no: the fill composites to 1.14/1.27 dark and 1.08/1.21 light, border 1.23/1.34. **No navy-on-navy surface in this palette can reach 3:1.**

#### P11 (#113)
- Process: the plan's "`template/*` are generated; edit `prototype/` and rebuild" **could not be followed as written** — no npm script existed, the path was wrong, and the generated output was being prettier-formatted after generation (a no-op rebuild produced a 4,781-line whole-file diff).
- 10 numbered deviations, the visually material ones: re-anchored `--bg`/`--navy-900` too (D9a named only three navy tokens); shifted the **whole** `--text-*` ramp rather than just `--text-4` (fixing `--text-4` alone would have made it lighter than `--text-3`, inverting the ramp); panel alpha 0.82→0.90; `.pop` blur aligned to `.panel` (18/1.4 → 16/1.45); `.mapboxgl-ctrl-group button` sized to 44×44.

#### P12 (#111)
- Six deviations, all *deletions* the plan did not list: **no `.notice` class** (D10a collapses both plan rows into one component); `.subsection`/`.subsection-title` deleted; `.header`/`.footer` alias selectors deleted; two `::before` neutralizers deleted; `<h1>` is the **document name, not the agency** (the unit moved to a subtitle, hence `.header h2` → `.header .unit`); `role="alert"` **not preserved** on the no-sync callout.

#### P13 (#124)
- **D1** `MapControls.tsx` and `MapScaleBar.tsx` **were not opened** — deliberately, to avoid firing DEF-UI-015's design question. Verified by the aggregator: the two off-scale sizes in those files (`fontSize: 11`, `fontSize: 10`) have **no token to convert to**, so the exclusion cost the sweep nothing.
- **D2** font sizes **10 / 11 / 13 / 15 / 22 were not converted** — 19 live sites across 14 files, no scale step exists (became DEF-UI-027).
- **D3** off-scale radii (1, 2, 5, 6) not rounded.
- **D4** three of the four "off-recipe shadows" **refuted at source** — the recipe does not describe those surfaces.
- **D5** `TerminalLine` / `TimerCard` / `InitFailureScreen` line heights left raw.
- **D6 WITHDRAWN** (`PhotoList.tsx` fontSize 7) — the deviation itself was wrong.
- The phase's first deliverable was a **fresh census against `main`**, because the plan's counts were measured pre-campaign and twelve merged phases had already consumed most of them (e.g. `borderRadius: <n>` 97 → 41 live).

#### PR #125 — post-campaign UI triage (`fix/post-campaign-ui-triage` → `2d4defa3`, merged 2026-08-23)

Not a campaign phase. 10 issues, 22 commits, 46 files, over **four device-verified rounds on the owner's physical iPhone**. Merge base `f8773904`.

Two structural findings the PR body flags up front, both directly relevant to a web port:

1. **The campaign measured *text on* surfaces and never *surfaces against their parents*.** That blind spot shipped two flat tiers — `nestedCard` at ΔE 0.6 and `recessed` at ΔE 16.3 *off* the ramp. Both are now pinned in `palette-contrast.test.ts` using CIE76 ΔE, not contrast ratio.
2. Several "defects" were **test mocks silently disagreeing with the real library**, not product bugs. Five found and fixed.

## 2 Recipe and component-family delta

**This section is the heart of the port.** §1 says which token values moved; this section says what
the *shapes* are now — the canonical recipe for each shared visual family as it exists in code at
`main`, what it replaced, and which components consume it.

### How to read it

Every entry follows the same shape:

- **Status** — `NEW since baseline` / `CHANGED` / `UNCHANGED (formatting only)`. Decided by reading
  the diff past the prettier churn (§0.4), not from the diffstat. **This is the column to trust.**
- **Phase/PR** — from `git log --oneline d9606460..main -- <file>`.
- **Canonical recipe NOW** — every style prop with its literal value *and* the token it comes from,
  cited at the current line at `main`. `StyleSheet.create` blocks and inline style objects are copied
  verbatim rather than paraphrased, so a value is never lost in translation. Where a file forks on
  `colorScheme`, both branches are given and the dark one is marked. **The demo is dark-only: read
  the dark branch.**
- **What it replaced** — the old values, from `git show d9606460:<path>`.
- **Consumers** — who renders it.
- **Notes** — the in-file comment that explains a decision, a measured contrast ratio, a ruling
  (D1–D13, M1–M6) or a DEF-UI ledger row.

### The seven subsections

| § | Scope | Fragment size |
|---|---|---|
| **2.A** | Shared common component library — `Card`, `Button`, `GlassBottomSheet`, `TextInput`, `Picker`, `RadioGroup`, `Checkbox`, `Switch`, `Banner`, `GlassDot`, `GlassAccentStrip`, `ScrollableTextInput`, plus the `withAlpha`/`flattenOver` and `ThemeContext` theming seam | ~1 380 lines |
| **2.B** | App chrome and shell — the four header components, drawer, `Screen`, `GridBackground`, scanner HUD, the three route shells, splash / lock / error screens | ~2 735 lines |
| **2.C** | Map view — PR #118 Phase 1 *and* the PR #127 redesign, including the new `MapFiltersSheet` and collapsed search bar | ~2 685 lines |
| **2.D** | Case cards, status badges, case modals, export hub, location controls | ~3 570 lines |
| **2.E** | Wizard screens, `FormSection`, date/time pickers, sync card, notes and form-customization | ~1 560 lines |
| **2.F** | Settings, export security, agency cloud, export and preview modals | ~1 320 lines |
| **2.G** | Import (PDF + JSON), OCR, audio recording, media capture and library | ~3 400 lines |

### The families, and where each one's canonical recipe lives

The audit's headline finding was **8 card families**. They are now one, plus a deliberate tier
system. This index maps each shared family to the file that defines it and the subsection that
documents it.

| Family | Canonical definition at `main` | Documented in |
|---|---|---|
| Card (top-level) | `src/components/common/Card.tsx` — `<Card glass>` | §2.A |
| Nested card | same, `glassVariant="nestedCard"` (radius stays `lg` = 12; see §1.5) | §2.A |
| Elevated / modal | same, `glassVariant="elevated"` + `Layout.shadow.dialog` | §2.A, §2.F |
| Nested **row** (not a card) | hand-rolled at `Layout.borderRadius.md` (8) per D13 — `LocationItem`, `CompactLocationItem`, `Banner` | §2.A, §2.D |
| Bottom sheet / picker | `src/components/common/GlassBottomSheet.tsx` + `GlassColors[scheme].sheet` + `Layout.shadow.sheet` + `borderRadius.sheet` (22) | §2.A |
| Recessed well (drum, option list, calendar) | `GlassColors[scheme].recessed` | §1.3, §2.E |
| Header bar | `Header` / `MainHeader` / `ModalHeader` / `OverlayHeader` + `GlassColors[scheme].header` | §2.B |
| Drawer items | `src/components/layout/CustomDrawerContent.tsx` | §2.B |
| Tab bar | `app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx` | §2.B |
| Buttons — primary / secondary / outline / ghost / danger | `src/components/common/Button.tsx` + `PrimaryButtonGradient` + `ElevatedEdges` + `DangerFill` | §2.A, §1.4 |
| Chips / badges / status pills | `src/features/case-management/components/CaseStatusBadge.tsx` (`severityConfig`) + the `*Light` / `*OnLight` quartets | §2.D |
| Map status colour | `map-view/utils/status-severity.ts` (`STATUS_SEVERITY` / `STATUS_ACCENT`) — **no longer `PIN_COLORS`** | §2.C |
| Inputs / `TextInput` / scanner mono | `src/components/common/TextInput.tsx`, `Typography.fontFamily.scannerMono` | §2.A |
| Pickers / dropdowns | `src/components/common/Picker.tsx` | §2.A |
| Date / time pickers | `src/components/form/DateTimePicker.tsx`, `TimeWheelPicker/`, `CalendarPicker.styles.ts` | §2.E |
| Dialogs / alerts | `DeleteConfirmationModal`, `PasswordModal` (+ `Layout.shadow.dialog`) | §2.D, §2.F |
| Inline notices / banners | `src/components/common/Banner.tsx` | §2.A |
| Empty states | `src/features/case-management/components/EmptyState.tsx` (inert), `EmptyMediaState` | §2.D, §2.G |
| List rows | settings row (§2.F), location rows (§2.D), map rows (§2.C), media rows (§2.G) | as noted |
| Section headers | `src/components/form/FormSection.tsx` (wizard), settings section header (§2.F) | §2.E, §2.F |
| Terminal | `src/features/import/pdf-import/constants/terminal-palette.ts` | §2.G |
| Shadows | `Layout.shadow.{card,dialog,sheet}` | §1.5 |
| Always-dark subtree | `ForceColorScheme` — `src/context/ThemeContext.tsx:130`, exactly four call sites | §2.G |

**`ForceColorScheme` deserves a callout for the web port.** It is a nested theme-context override
(`ThemeContext.tsx:130`) that pins `colorScheme` / `colors` / `isDark` for a subtree while
`toggleTheme` / `setColorScheme` pass through. Ruling **D6(a)** created it. There are exactly four
non-test call sites, all `scheme="dark"`: `NotesSectionEditor.tsx:110`,
`ImportTerminalProgress.tsx:343`, `MediaPreviewFullscreen.tsx:134`, `OcrCaptureFlow.tsx:112`.
Two important corrections to what the rulings doc implies: the **audio recorder does not use it**
(D11(a) made it genuinely theme-aware instead) and the **video/photo camera does not either** (it is
still hardcoded-dark with raw literals). And the map's floating chrome, which D3(a) said would stay
always-dark, was superseded by PR #127 — it is theme-aware via an `isDark` prop with no
`ForceColorScheme` anywhere. See §5.1.

### `Card` — `src/components/common/Card.tsx`

**Status:** CHANGED (253 lines at `main`; +113/−? vs baseline)

**Phase/PR:** `91c98ed2` "read the card shadow from Layout.shadow.card" and `11541019` "stop glass Card doubling the padding when style sets it" → **PR #112 (ui-consistency-p0)**; `2ff9c794` "route every painted-surface style to the surface that paints" and `2b60f679` "delete the dead colorScheme fallbacks" → **PR #123 (ui-consistency-p9)**; `d1739700` prettier → PR #106.

**Props / variants:** `CardProps`, `Card.tsx:8-23`.

| prop | type | default | file:line |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` | `ReactNode` | — | `Card.tsx:10` |
| `style` | `StyleProp<ViewStyle>` | — | `Card.tsx:12` |
| `padding` | `keyof typeof Layout.spacing` (`xxs\|xs\|xsm\|sm\|base\|md\|mdlg\|lg\|xl\|xxl`) | `'md'` (16) | `Card.tsx:14`, default at `:47` |
| `testID` | `string` | — | `Card.tsx:16` |
| `techGlow` | `boolean` | `false` | `Card.tsx:18`, default `:49` |
| `glass` | `boolean` | `false` | `Card.tsx:20`, default `:50` |
| `glassVariant` | `GlassVariant` = `'card'\|'nestedCard'\|'elevated'\|'header'\|'sheet'\|'recessed'` | `'card'` | `Card.tsx:22`, default `:51` |

**Canonical recipe NOW:**

`StyleSheet.create` block verbatim (`Card.tsx:216-253`):

```js
const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  card: {
    borderRadius: Layout.borderRadius.lg,   // 12
    borderWidth: 1,
    // Shadow styles are applied dynamically based on theme
  },
  glassContainer: {
    position: 'relative',
    borderRadius: Layout.borderRadius.lg,   // 12
    overflow: 'hidden',
  },
  highlight: {
    position: 'absolute',
    top: 0, left: 0, right: 0,
    height: 1,
    zIndex: 1,
  },
  gradient: {
    borderRadius: Layout.borderRadius.lg,   // 12
    borderWidth: 1,
  },
})
```

Dynamic styles:

- `glowStyle` (`Card.tsx:57-65`) — applied **only when `techGlow && colorScheme === 'dark'`**, otherwise `{}`:
  ```js
  { shadowColor: colors.primary /* dark #2B8CC1 */, shadowOpacity: 0.15, shadowRadius: 8, elevation: 4 }
  ```
- `shadowStyle` (`Card.tsx:68`) — `Layout.shadow.card[isLightMode ? 'light' : 'dark']`; literals in the token table above. Light: `rgba(30,58,138,0.18)` / `0,+3` / opacity 1 / radius 8 / elev 4. Dark: `#000` / `0,+4` / opacity 0.15 / radius 8 / elev 4.
- **Solid branch** (`Card.tsx:196-213`): `styles.card` + `shadowStyle` + `{ backgroundColor: colors.card, borderColor: colors.border, padding: Layout.spacing[padding] }` + `glowStyle` + caller `style` (caller style wins, applied last).
- **Glass branch** (`Card.tsx:71-193`): three-node structure.
  1. Wrapper `<View style={[styles.glassContainer, shadowStyle, glowStyle, layoutStyle, outerStyle]}>` (`:166-169`).
  2. Highlight `<View style={[styles.highlight, { backgroundColor: glassStyle.highlightTop }]}>` (`:171-174`) — a 1px absolutely-positioned bar at `top: 0`, `zIndex: 1`.
  3. `<LinearGradient colors={[...glassStyle.gradient]} start={{x:0,y:0}} end={{x:0,y:1}} style={[styles.gradient, { borderColor: glassStyle.border, padding: Layout.spacing[padding] }, contentStyle]}>` (`:175-188`). **Vertical, top→bottom, two stops.**
  - `glassStyle = GlassColors[colorScheme][glassVariant]` (`Card.tsx:72`).
- **The style-routing contract** (`Card.tsx:94-163`) — the demo must replicate this or callers' styles silently vanish. Destructured off the caller's `style` and **moved to the gradient** (`contentStyle`): `alignItems`, `justifyContent`, `flexDirection`, `flexWrap` (`:119-122`); `padding`, `paddingHorizontal`, `paddingVertical`, `paddingTop`, `paddingBottom`, `paddingLeft`, `paddingRight`, `paddingStart`, `paddingEnd` (`:125-133`); `gap`, `rowGap`, `columnGap` (`:134-136`); `borderColor`, `borderWidth` (`:137-138`). `borderRadius` goes to **BOTH** wrapper and gradient (`:143-147`). `flex` goes to the wrapper AND sets `contentStyle.flex = 1`; so does a `height` or `minHeight` left in `layoutStyle` (`:157-163`). Everything else stays on the wrapper as `layoutStyle`.
  - Assignments are guarded `!== undefined` "so an absent key never lands as an explicit `undefined`, which would blank out the gradient's default padding" (`Card.tsx:123-124`).
- **testIDs:** container = `testID`; highlight = `` `${testID}-highlight` `` (`:173`); gradient = `` `${testID}-gradient` `` (`:187`).

**What it replaced** (`git show d9606460:src/components/common/Card.tsx`):

- `shadowStyle` was an inline theme ternary carrying the identical literals; now `Layout.shadow.card[...]` (same values, no visual change).
- `GlassColors[colorScheme ?? 'light']` → `GlassColors[colorScheme]` (dead fallback deleted, `2b60f679`).
- The destructure used to pull **only** `alignItems, justifyContent, flexDirection, flexWrap`. Everything else — padding family, `gap`/`rowGap`/`columnGap`, `borderColor`/`borderWidth`/`borderRadius`, `flex` — stayed on the wrapper and was therefore invisible. Concrete regressions named in-file: `style={{ padding: 24 }}` rendered **40px** of inset (24 wrapper + 16 gradient default); PR #118's `camerasToggleCard` rendered its icon flush against its label because `gap` was inert (`Card.tsx:80-88`).
- `outerStyle` (the `borderRadius`/`flex` wrapper channel) is entirely new.
- `styles.card`, `styles.glassContainer`, `styles.highlight`, `styles.gradient` values are **UNCHANGED** from baseline.

**Consumers** (`grep -rn "from '@/components/common/Card'"`, tests excluded — 28 files):
`app/(form)/completion.tsx`, `app/(form)/dvr-information.tsx`, `app/(form)/extracted-video-scope.tsx`, `app/(form)/time-offset.tsx`, `src/components/export/ExportModal.tsx`, `src/components/form/ArrayFieldManager.tsx`, `src/features/agency-cloud/components/UserManagementModal.tsx`, `src/features/agency-cloud/components/steps/OrgPlanStep.tsx`, `src/features/agency-cloud/components/steps/ProjectStep.tsx`, `src/features/case-management/components/CaseActionsSheet.tsx`, `src/features/case-management/components/CaseCard.tsx`, `src/features/case-management/components/DashboardCaseCard.tsx`, `src/features/case-management/components/DeleteConfirmationModal.tsx`, `src/features/form-customization/components/FormCustomizationSection.tsx`, `src/features/import/json-import/components/BatchResultDetails.tsx`, `.../ImportFlowModal.tsx`, `.../ImportPickerModal.tsx`, `.../ImportResultBody.tsx`, `src/features/location/map-view/components/LocationDetailCard.tsx`, `src/features/media/audio-recording/components/AudioPreview.tsx`, `.../TimerCard.tsx`, `src/features/media/video-image-capture/components/PhotoPreview.tsx`, `.../VideoPreview.tsx`, `src/features/ocr-time-capture/components/ConfirmationScreen.tsx`, `src/features/precision-time-sync/components/SyncStatusCard.tsx`, `.../TimeSyncErrorBoundary.tsx`, `src/features/settings/cloud-sync/components/CloudSyncSettingsSection.tsx`, `src/features/settings/components/SettingsCategoryList.tsx`.

**Notes:**

- **Ruling D13(a) is pinned in-file at `Card.tsx:237-248`:** the glass branch's radius is `lg` (12) for **every** `glassVariant`, deliberately. "nested rows md (8), top-level cards lg (12)"; `glassVariant` carries depth in the **gradient, not the corner**. Phase 1 prescribes `<Card glass glassVariant="nestedCard">` at `borderRadius.lg` for four `LocationDetailCard` sites. Keying radius off `glassVariant` "needs an owner decision"; the same guard is duplicated at `src/constants/Layout.ts:25-41`. A caller needing a different corner passes `style={{ borderRadius }}`.
- Ledger refs in file: **DEF-UI-008** and **DEF-UI-013** (`Card.tsx:93`).
- `src/constants/Colors.ts:378` notes "the iOS shadow on this component is dead (see the note in Card.tsx) and repairing it is held" — i.e. the dark glass card's shadow does not actually render on iOS.

**Canonical recipe NOW:**

Base (`Button.tsx:81-92`):

```js

  borderRadius: Layout.borderRadius.control,  // 10 — all five variants
  borderWidth: 1 }
```

Sizes (`Button.tsx:95-111`):

```js
medium: { paddingHorizontal: Layout.spacing.lg, /*24*/ paddingVertical: Layout.spacing.md, /*16*/ minHeight: Layout.touchTarget.comfortable }  // 48

```

Variant container styles (`Button.tsx:114-162`):

```js
primary: {
  backgroundColor: isDisabled ? colors.disabled : 'transparent',
  borderColor:     isDisabled ? colors.disabled : 'transparent',
  overflow: 'hidden',
  borderWidth: 1,
  borderTopColor:    isDisabled ? colors.disabled : ElevatedEdges[colorScheme].top,     // dark rgba(255,255,255,0.14) / light rgba(255,255,255,0.35)
  borderBottomColor: isDisabled ? colors.disabled : ElevatedEdges[colorScheme].bottom,  // dark rgba(0,0,0,0.3)        / light rgba(0,0,0,0.1)
  borderLeftColor: 'transparent',
  borderRightColor: 'transparent',
  // + when NOT disabled, a theme-branched drop shadow:
  //   DARK  (Button.tsx:127-133): shadowColor '#000000',              offset {0, 6}, opacity 0.45, radius 20, elevation 8
  //   LIGHT (Button.tsx:134-140): shadowColor 'rgba(30, 58, 138, 1)', offset {0, 6}, opacity 0.22, radius 20, elevation 6
}
secondary: { backgroundColor: isDisabled ? colors.disabled : colors.backgroundSecondary,
             borderColor:     isDisabled ? colors.disabled : colors.border }
outline:   { backgroundColor: 'transparent',
             borderColor:     isDisabled ? colors.disabled : colors.link }        // link, NOT primary
ghost:     { backgroundColor: 'transparent', borderColor: 'transparent' }
danger:    { backgroundColor: isDisabled ? colors.disabled : dangerFill,
             borderColor:     isDisabled ? colors.disabled : dangerFill }         // dangerFill = DangerFill[colorScheme]: light #dc2626, dark #b72136
```

`fullWidth` adds `{ width: '100%' }` (`Button.tsx:168`).

The primary gradient is a separate absolutely-filled child, rendered only when `variant === 'primary' && !isDisabled` (`Button.tsx:279-286`):

```jsx
<LinearGradient colors={[...PrimaryButtonGradient[colorScheme]]}
                start={{ x: 0, y: 0 }} end={{ x: 0, y: 1 }}
                style={StyleSheet.absoluteFillObject} />
// light ['#2563eb', '#1d3584'] ; dark ['#1F6B99', '#17527A']
```

Text styles (`Button.tsx:173-243`): base `{ fontWeight: Typography.fontWeight.semibold /* '600' */, textAlign: 'center' }`. Sizes: `small` 14, `medium` 16, `large` 18 (`:181-189`). Variant colors (`:193-236`):

```js

           + when NOT disabled a textShadow:
             DARK  textShadowColor 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)', offset {0,1}, radius 1  (Button.tsx:205-207)
             LIGHT textShadowColor 'rgba(0,0,0,0.1)',        offset {0,1}, radius 1  (Button.tsx:210-212)
secondary: color = isDisabled ? colors.disabledText : colors.text
outline:   color = isDisabled ? colors.disabledText : colors.link
ghost:     color = isDisabled ? colors.disabledText : colors.link
danger:    color = isDisabled ? colors.disabledText : colors.onError     // #ffffff both themes
```

Spinner (`Button.tsx:252-260`): `variant === 'danger' ? colors.onError : variant === 'primary' ? colors.onPrimary : colors.link`. `<ActivityIndicator size="small" color={spinnerColor} />` (`:294`). Spinner is **delayed 500ms** (`Button.tsx:69`) to avoid flash; while shown, the label is kept mounted at `opacity: 0` to preserve height (`styles.hiddenContent`, `:290-292`) and the indicator overlays via `styles.loadingOverlay`.

Static styles (`Button.tsx:306-316`):

```js

loadingOverlay: { ...StyleSheet.absoluteFillObject, flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }
```

Touchable: `<TouchableOpacity activeOpacity={0.7}>` (`Button.tsx:270`), `accessibilityRole="button"` (`:276`), haptic `safeImpactAsync()` on press (`:265`).

**What it replaced:**

| what | OLD (`d9606460`) | NOW |
|---|---|---|

| `primary` radius override | literal `borderRadius: 10` inside the variant | deleted — base carries it |
| `outline` radius override | literal `borderRadius: 10` inside the variant | deleted |
| `secondary`/`ghost`/`danger` radius | inherited base **8** — visibly different corners next to a primary in `ExportModal` | now all 10 |
| primary top edge | inline `colorScheme === 'dark' ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.14)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.35)'` | `ElevatedEdges[colorScheme].top` (byte-identical) |
| primary bottom edge | inline `'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.1)'` | `ElevatedEdges[colorScheme].bottom` (byte-identical) |
| primary gradient | module-local `PRIMARY_GRADIENT`: dark `['#35A0D6', '#2580AD']`, light `['#2563eb', '#1d3584']` | `PrimaryButtonGradient`: dark → **`['#1F6B99', '#17527A']`** (darkened), light unchanged |
| primary label | `colors.textInverse` (dark = `#002853` navy) | `colors.onPrimary` (`#ffffff`) |
| `outline` border | `colors.primary` | `colors.link` |
| `outline` label | `colors.primary` | `colors.link` |
| `ghost` label | `colors.primary` | `colors.link` |
| `danger` fill + border | `colors.error` (light `#ef4444`, dark `#ff4757`) | `DangerFill[colorScheme]` (light `#dc2626`, dark `#b72136`) |
| `danger` label | `colors.textInverse` | `colors.onError` (`#ffffff`) |
| spinner color | `variant === 'primary' \|\| variant === 'danger' ? colors.textInverse : colors.primary` | three-way: `onError` / `onPrimary` / `link` |
| haptics | `Haptics.impactAsync(Haptics.ImpactFeedbackStyle.Light)` | `safeImpactAsync()` |

Sizes, base flex properties, shadows and text shadows are **unchanged**.

**Notes / documented contrast:**

- **`PrimaryButtonGradient` derivation** (`Colors.ts:444-470`): with `onPrimary` `#ffffff` — dark `#1F6B99` → **5.80:1**, `#17527A` → **8.32:1**; light `#2563eb` → **5.17:1**, `#1d3584` → **11.08:1**. The shipped dark recipe `['#35A0D6','#2580AD']` measured **2.94:1** at its worst. "Do NOT lighten either dark stop and do NOT 'tokenise' the light pair to `[primaryLight, primaryDark]`" (the swap takes 5.17 → 3.68). Pinned by `__tests__/palette-contrast.test.ts`.
- **DEF-UI-018** (`Button.tsx:218-223`): `outline`/`ghost` label with `link`. As 16px semibold on glass, `primary` measured **2.87:1 on `card`** and **2.81:1 on `nestedCard`** in dark vs AA 4.5:1; `link` measures **6.86 dark / 7.16 light**. 39 call sites. The `disabledText` branches are deliberately not chased (WCAG 1.4.3 exempts inactive controls).
- **DEF-UI-001** (`Button.tsx:56-60`, `Colors.ts:492-509`): with `onError` `#ffffff` — flat `error` **3.34 dark / 3.76 light (FAIL)**; `errorDark` in both **4.10 dark / 4.83 light (dark fails)**; the shipped `DangerFill` pair **6.39 dark / 4.83 light (PASS)**.
- **D7a** (`Colors.ts:91-96`, `:196-202`): `onPrimary` on `primary` measures 10.36:1 light; dark `onPrimary` on `primary` 3.73:1 (AA-large only) but 5.80:1 on `primaryDark`; dark `onError` on `error` 3.34:1 but 6.39:1 on `errorLight`.
- **D4a** ruling reference at `Button.tsx:89` — 10 is the named `control` tier: "inputs, pills, chips and small tap targets".
- **PR #123 F5** (`Button.tsx:245-251`): danger's spinner was reading `onPrimary`. Invisible today because both are `#ffffff` in both themes.

Dynamic / theme-branched:

- `glassStyle = GlassColors[colorScheme].sheet` (`:164`); `headerStyle = GlassColors[colorScheme].header` (`:165`).
- `sheetShadow = Layout.shadow.sheet[isDark ? 'dark' : 'light']` (`:171`).

- **Sheet node** (`:403-451`): `styles.sheet` + `{ maxHeight: `${Math.round(maxHeightRatio*100)}%`, borderColor: glassStyle.border, borderTopColor: glassStyle.highlightTop }` + (if `fillHeight`) `{ height: `${Math.round(maxHeightRatio*100)}%`, paddingTop: insets.top }` + **always** `{ paddingBottom: insets.bottom }` (`:445`) + `sheetShadow` + `sheetAnimatedStyle`.
- **Sheet ground** (`:456-462`): `<LinearGradient colors={glassStyle.gradient} start={{x:0,y:0}} end={{x:0,y:1}} style={StyleSheet.absoluteFill} />`. Dark `['rgba(0,40,83,0.98)','rgba(14,57,101,1)']`, light `['rgba(255,255,255,1)','rgba(241,245,249,1)']`.
- **Handle color** (`:308`): `withAlpha(colors.textSecondary, isDark ? 0.25 : 0.35)` → dark `rgba(153,186,221,0.25)`, light `rgba(75,85,99,0.35)`.
- **Header band** (`:316-321`): `<LinearGradient colors={headerStyle.gradient} start={{x:0,y:0}} end={{x:0,y:1}} style={[styles.header, { borderBottomColor: headerStyle.border }]}>`. Dark `['rgba(0,38,80,0.95)','rgba(2,46,89,0.98)']` border `rgba(28,78,132,0.6)`; light `['rgba(255,255,255,0.98)','rgba(248,250,252,0.95)']` border `rgba(148,163,184,0.4)`.
- **Accent dot** (`:323-334`): `{ backgroundColor: colors.primary }`, plus in **dark only** `{ shadowColor: colors.primary, shadowOffset: {0,0}, shadowOpacity: 0.4, shadowRadius: 4 }`.
- **Title** (`:336-350`): `{ color: colors.text }`, plus in **dark only** `{ textShadowColor: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)', textShadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 1 }, textShadowRadius: 2 }`. `numberOfLines={1}`.
- **Subtitle** (`:352-357`): `{ color: colors.textSecondary }`.
- **Accent strip** (`:365-367`): `<GlassAccentStrip />` when `showAccentStrip` and `title` — see its own section.
- **Body**: `<View style={fillHeight ? styles.bodyFill : styles.body}>` (`:470`).
- **Footer**: `{footer && <View style={styles.footer}>{footer}</View>}` (`:472`).

Motion (all Reanimated; RN `Modal` has `animationType="none"`, `:380`):

- `progress` shared value 0→1; enter `withTiming(1, { duration: 260 })`, exit `withTiming(0, { duration: 200 })` (`:215`, `:219`).
- Sheet transform (`:254-260`): `translateY: translateY.value + (1 - progress.value) * (sheetHeight.value || SCREEN_HEIGHT)`.
- Backdrop opacity (`:265-274`): `progress.value * interpolate(translateY.value, [0, sheetHeight || SCREEN_HEIGHT], [1, 0], Extrapolation.CLAMP)`.
- Drag: `Gesture.Pan().activeOffsetY(10)` (`:243-252`), clamped `Math.max(0, e.translationY)`. Dismiss animation `withTiming(sheetHeight || SCREEN_HEIGHT, { duration: 180 })` (`:229-235`); spring-back `withSpring(0, { damping: 22, stiffness: 240 })` (`:237`).
- Enter has **two entry points** — the effect (only if `sheetHeight.value > 0`, `:215`) and `onSheetLayout` on first measurement (`:287-289`) — guarded by `isExiting` shared value.
- `mounted` state trails `visible` so the exit can play before unmount (`:196`, `:222`).

testIDs: sheet = `testID`; `-overlay`, `-backdrop`, `-ground`, `-title`, `-subtitle`, `-accent-strip`.

A11y: `accessibilityViewIsModal` on the overlay (`:391`); scrim gets `accessibilityRole="button"` + `accessibilityLabel={closeLabel}` only when `dismissOnBackdropPress` (`:396-399`); `onRequestClose={onClose}` for Android back (`:381`); `statusBarTranslucent` (`:382`).

**Notes:**

- **DEF-UI-006** (`GlassBottomSheet.tsx:98-105`, `:385-388`): `ExportActionSheet`'s scrim label degraded from "Close export options" to a bare "Close" when it folded in; hence `closeLabel`. `accessibilityViewIsModal` is needed because "RN's own `<Modal>` host view blunts most of the leakage on iOS, but not all of it, and nothing blunts it on the scrim/sheet siblings here."
- **DEF-UI-023** (`GlassBottomSheet.tsx:431-444`): the bottom inset is reserved on BOTH paths. None of the five consumers reserves it (zero hits for `useSafeAreaInsets` / `SafeAreaView` / `insets` in Picker, TimePicker, DateTimePicker, ExportActionSheet, ExportCaseCard). Padding sits on the sheet node, not the children, so the ground gradient keeps painting behind the home indicator.
- **DEF-065** (`GlassBottomSheet.tsx:283-286`): the `!isExiting.value` term in `onSheetLayout` is **not test-pinnable** — deleting it leaves the suite green. "Do not remove it on that evidence."
- Handle geometry comment (`:504-506`): "40x4 at radius 2 is the pill `map-view/SheetHandle.tsx` deliberately matches. Tokenising it would let the two drift apart" — note the file nonetheless now uses `borderRadius.full`; the 40×4 dimensions are the pinned part.
- Header horizontal padding is explicitly aligned to `Picker`'s option rows (`:516`).
- `GlassColors.dark.sheet` comment (`Colors.ts:398-400`) names the three hand-rolled navies it replaced: `#0f2035` (GlassBottomSheet), `#04305c` (TimePicker), `#0b1624` (MediaLibrarySheet).
- `Colors.ts:218-231` on the dark scrim: alpha moved 0.9 → **0.32** because 0.9 "blacked the app out behind an open sheet instead of dimming it". `overlay` stayed at 0.9. "Deliberate — do NOT 'resync' the two." Pinned by `palette-contrast.test.ts`.
- `ponytail:` comment at `:24-26` — `SCREEN_HEIGHT` is frozen at module load; only the pre-first-`onLayout` fallback.

WCAG 1.4.3 exempts inactive components, but a disabled field in this app carries data the analyst has to read, not an unavailable control. `colors.textSecondary` measures **4.83:1 / 7.30:1** and keeps the AA pass." Placeholder is `textTertiary`, which carries the documented AA ceiling (dark **4.23:1** on `card`, ruling M2b — `Colors.ts:142-148`; light **3.87:1** on the worst light glass stop — `Colors.ts:32-40`, open owner question **DEF-063**).

**Consumers:** **none currently.** `git grep -ln "ScrollableTextInput" -- src app` returns only its own file, its test, and a comment mention in `src/components/layout/FormLayout.tsx:26` ("Set to false for screens with custom scroll handling (e.g., ScrollableTextInput)"). No file imports it.

**Notes:** the module docblock (`:1-26`) documents the problem it exists for: releasing a finger after scrolling inside a multiline RN `TextInput` focuses it and raises the keyboard. Solution = native `ScrollView` physics + a gesture-handler tap for controlled focus, plus `useKeyboardHandler` overlap math (`overlap = textBoxBottomY - (screenHeight - keyboardHeight) + 20`).

  ```js

                 : pressed    ? inkTint(isDark ? 0.03 : 0.015)
                 : 'transparent'
  borderColor:    isSelected ? accentTint(isDark ? 0.18 : 0.08) : 'transparent'
  borderTopColor: isSelected ? accentTint(isDark ? 0.22 : 0.1)  : 'transparent'
  ```

- `flexShrink: 1` note (`:178-191`): in a 3-up row at 360dp inside the settings detail pane, each label gets **~39px** of text budget (~44px at 375dp) against ~62px for "Forensic", ~54px "Limited", ~53px "Canvas". Inert at the 2-up call site (`app/(form)/requested-scope.tsx:140`).
- `direction` doc (`:20-25`): "three sentence labels in an even-share row have roughly 40px of text budget each at 360dp."

**Notes** (`GlassAccentStrip.tsx:1-18`): "It exists as a component because the recipe shipped twice, byte for byte… The dark copies invented `rgba(53, 160, 214, ...)`, which is in no palette, and the light copies used Tailwind blues that are not `Colors.light.primary`. Deriving every stop from `colors.primary` means the strip follows a palette change instead of being repainted by hand. The alpha ramp is per-theme on purpose: the dark primary is a mid-tone that needs real presence over a navy sheet, while the light primary is a deep navy that would read as a hard bar at the same alphas over white."

### `withAlpha` / `flattenOver` — `src/lib/utils/with-alpha.ts`

**Status:** **NEW since baseline** (83 lines; `src/lib/utils/with-alpha.ts` does not exist at `d9606460` — confirmed by `git ls-tree d9606460 src/lib/utils/`)

**Phase/PR:** `8abe15e9` "extract withAlpha to src/lib/utils and make it handle rgba inputs" → **PR #112 (ui-consistency-p0)**. `flattenOver` landed with `fb14d6b1` "re-anchor the recessed well onto the ramp, and flatten it properly" → **PR #125**.

**Exports:**

```ts
export function withAlpha(color: string, alpha: number): string     // with-alpha.ts:25
export function flattenOver(top: string, bottom: string): string    // with-alpha.ts:75
// private:
function parseColor(color: string): [number, number, number, number] | null   // with-alpha.ts:33
```

**`withAlpha(color, alpha)`** (`with-alpha.ts:25-30`): parses `#rgb`, `#rrggbb`, `rgb(…)` or `rgba(…)` and returns `` `rgba(${r}, ${g}, ${b}, ${alpha})` `` — **the input's own alpha is discarded, not multiplied.** Anything unparseable (named colours, `transparent`) is returned unchanged.

`parseColor` (`with-alpha.ts:33-59`):
- rgb/rgba regex: `/^rgba?\(\s*([\d.]+)\s*,\s*([\d.]+)\s*,\s*([\d.]+)\s*(?:,\s*([\d.]+)\s*)?\)/i` → `[r, g, b, a ?? 1]`
- hex regex: `/^#([0-9a-f]{3}|[0-9a-f]{6})$/i`; 3-digit expands by doubling each digit; alpha `1`
- anything else → `null`

**`flattenOver(top, bottom)`** (`with-alpha.ts:75-83`): source-over compositing. `mix(i) = Math.round(t[i] * a + b[i] * (1 - a))` where `a = top`'s alpha; returns `` `rgb(${r}, ${g}, ${b})` ``. **`bottom`'s own alpha is IGNORED** — it is treated as the opaque surface. Returns `top` unchanged if either is unparseable.

**How consumers use it — the theming seam:**

Every derived tint in the shared library goes through `withAlpha` rather than hex-concat. Sites in scope:
- `GlassBottomSheet.tsx:308` — handle glyph: `withAlpha(colors.textSecondary, isDark ? 0.25 : 0.35)`
- `GlassAccentStrip.tsx:43-47` — all five gradient stops: `withAlpha(colors.primary, 0 | shoulder | peak)`
- `GlassDot.tsx:39` glow, `:53` highlight, `:67` gradient top stop
- `Picker.tsx:63-64` — `accentTint` / `inkTint` factories; `:241` indicator-dot border
- `RadioGroup.tsx:75` — selected fill

35 files across the app import from `@/lib/utils/with-alpha` (grep `with-alpha`), including `src/components/form/CalendarPicker.styles.ts`, `src/components/form/TimeWheelPicker/TimePicker.styles.ts`, `src/components/layout/GridBackground.tsx`, `src/features/location/map-view/constants/index.ts`, `src/features/media/media-library/constants.ts`.

**What it replaced** (`with-alpha.ts:1-23`): "It existed as four byte-identical private copies (`SettingsNavBar`, `SettingsCategoryRow`, `importResultUtils`, and as `hexToRgba` in `TimePicker.styles`) before this module, which is a large part of why rgba literals sprawled instead of being derived." Two bugs the copies had:
1. **`rgba()`/`rgb()` inputs.** Several tokens (`gridSubtle`, `grid`, `gridLight`, `overlay`, `overlayLight`, `scrim`, and **every `GlassColors` gradient stop**) are already rgba strings; the copies passed them through untouched, so the requested alpha was silently ignored. "The `token + '20'` string-concat idiom is worse still: on an rgba string it produces an unparseable colour." (This is exactly the bug `RadioGroup` carried — `` `${colors.primaryLight}15` ``.)
2. **3-digit hex**, which the copies read as `rgba(54, 15, NaN, …)`.

**Notes — the `flattenOver` trap** (`with-alpha.ts:64-73`): "The trap it exists to close is reaching for `withAlpha(token, 1)` instead: that does not flatten anything, it DISCARDS the alpha and hands back the raw triple, which is a colour the token was never meant to render at. That is not hypothetical. `GlassColors.dark.recessed.gradient[0]` is `rgba(6, 12, 22, 0.65)` — a wash designed to darken the sheet beneath it. `withAlpha(…, 1)` turned it into `#060c16`, near-black, and the time picker's drum shipped **27 CIE76 dE** away from its own sheet. Composited properly over that sheet it resolves to a navy **7.5 dE** away, which is a well." (Note the quoted value `rgba(6,12,22,0.65)` is pre-`fb14d6b1`; the current `dark.recessed.gradient[0]` is `rgba(0, 24, 50, 0.6)`.)

**For the demo:** `withAlpha` maps to a CSS `rgba()` builder over a parsed token, and `flattenOver` to manual source-over compositing — CSS `color-mix()` or a `rgba()` layered over an opaque background achieves the same. The important contract is that **`withAlpha` replaces, never multiplies, the source alpha**, and that a translucent `GlassColors` stop must be composited (not alpha-forced) whenever an API needs one flat colour.
