```js
function actionsForStatus(status: CaseStatus): StatusActions {
  switch (status) {
    case CaseStatus.DRAFT:
      return { canComplete: true, canReopen: false, canArchive: true }
    case CaseStatus.COMPLETE:
      return { canComplete: false, canReopen: true, canArchive: true }
    case CaseStatus.ARCHIVED:
      return { canComplete: false, canReopen: true, canArchive: false }
    default:
      return assertNever(status)
  }
}
```

Button set and variants (CaseActionsSheet.tsx:317-344): `Edit Case` `variant="primary"` (always first), `Complete Case` `variant="primary"` (DRAFT only), `Reopen Case` `variant="outline"`, `Archive Case` `variant="outline"`, `Cancel` `variant="outline"`. In-file rationale (:314-316): *"Edit and Complete are the primary positive actions — blue gradient. Reopen / Archive / Cancel stay `outline` so the primary actions read first."*

Header labels: case number as title (:268), optional display name (:271), and `Status: {statusLabel}` (:275-277) where `statusLabel = status === CaseStatus.DRAFT ? 'Active' : status` (:134) — the same DRAFT→"Active" rename `CaseStatusBadge` performs.

Report group headings (uppercase via `textTransform`): `Case Personnel`, `Incident Location`, `Notes`, `Details`. Row labels: `Officer in Charge`, `Video Coordinator`, `Unit`, `Business`, `Address`, `City`, `Coordinates` (mono), `Locations`, `Created`.

**What it replaced.** The report panel was a bare `ScrollView` painted with a **mixed** surface (baseline, per `git diff`):

```jsx
<ScrollView
  style={[
    styles.report,
    { backgroundColor: colors.card, borderColor: glassStyle.border, maxHeight: reportMaxHeight },
  ]}
```

with

```js
report: {
  borderWidth: 1,
  borderRadius: Layout.borderRadius.md,
  overflow: 'hidden',
},
```

i.e. a **solid `colors.card` fill under a glass border**, radius `md` (8). It is now a nested glass `Card` at radius `lg` (12) with `padding: 0`. Also swapped: `reportValueMono.fontFamily: 'monospace'` → `Typography.fontFamily.mono`, and `notesText.lineHeight: 20` → `Typography.lineHeight.tight * Typography.fontSize.base` (same 20, now derived).

**Notes.** Header comment (:1-20) records the two reasons the sheet exists: *"Android's AlertDialog caps at 3 buttons; adding "Edit Case" to the existing Complete/Archive/Cancel stack pushes DRAFT/COMPLETE cases to 4 — which an Alert silently truncates on Android"* and *"It matches the in-repo DuplicateLocationModal pattern (also built to replace an iOS-only Alert)."* The report-card comment (:381-388) is quoted in the style block above. **BUG-008** is named at :151-154: coordinates are gated on `hasCapturedCoordinates`, not object presence — *"A stored (0,0) — zero-init or failed GPS fix — would otherwise render "0.000000, 0.000000" as an authoritative position in a court-facing record (Null Island is in the Gulf of Guinea, not Ontario)."* Coordinates format to 6 decimal places (:159).

with `header: { padding: Layout.spacing.lg, borderBottomWidth: 1 }` → **padding 24, 1px bottom rule**, and `title: { fontSize: Typography.fontSize['2xl'], fontWeight: Typography.fontWeight.bold }` → **24 / '700'**, coloured inline `colors.text`. 'Save Changes' : 'Create Case'}`, `disabled={isSubmitting || !formData.caseNumber.trim() || !formData.metadata.unit.trim()}`.

**What it replaced.** The local error callout — five byte-identical copies existed across the feature, each *"whose text was the saturated `colors.error` on a `colors.error + '20'` fill"* (the comment at :464-466 is the campaign's standing description of that recipe). Everything else in the style block was already tokenised.

**Notes.** The `defaultValue` + `onChangeText` policy is documented at NewCaseModal.tsx:274-284 and is a real behaviour contract worth porting:
> *"Every text field uses `defaultValue` + `onChangeText` (per-keystroke state sync), not `onEndEditing` (blur-only). onEndEditing loses a field's value when the user types it and taps Save/Create without first blurring — the press fires before the blur's setState flushes. This bit the VC badge (the last field a user typically touches) and would hit any field that's last-focused before submit. (Manual lat/long in IncidentLocationForm intentionally stay on onEndEditing — controlled number inputs break decimal typing.)"*

The read-only case number (:285-288): *"the case's directory_name (filesystem folder) is immutable and derived from this value at creation, and the rename/duplicate path isn't wired."* The `mode`/`initialCase` union is documented at :43-55 as making `{ mode: 'edit' }` without `initialCase` a compile error.

**The one divergence from the shared footer recipe: this file adds `marginTop: Layout.spacing.lg` = 24** on top of `paddingTop: 24`, giving 48pt of clearance between the form and the rule. `NewCaseModal` / `NewLocationModal` have `paddingTop` only.

Body: `<Banner severity="error" message={submitError} style={styles.errorBanner} />` (:125) then `<IncidentLocationForm values onChange onReverseGeocodeError testID="incident-location-form" />` (:128-133).

**What it replaced.** The local error callout → `Banner`. Note the errorBanner comment is the same five-copy note (:182-184).

**Notes.** Header comment (:1-17) records the scope split: *"Full-record editing stays exclusive to the dashboard long-press sheet's "Edit Case" → NewCaseModal flow. On save this emits ONLY the incident fields (via the shared mapper), so the parent's `updateCase` leaves the rest of the case untouched."* Reverse-geocode failures are routed to the banner (:72-77), *"mirrors NewCaseModal's wiring."*

### `ExportCaseCard` — `src/features/case-management/export-hub/components/ExportCaseCard.tsx`

**Role:** The Export tab's accordion case card — tri-state case checkbox, expandable location list, and "lit-follows-open" emphasis (the OPEN case gets the elevated gradient + accent border + accent glow; every other card dims while any case is open).

**Canonical recipe NOW — hand-rolled, deliberately, for the iOS shadow reason.**

Three-layer structure (ExportCaseCard.tsx:125-152):

```jsx
<View
  style={[
    styles.wrapper,
    isExpanded ? styles.wrapperLit : styles.wrapperIdle,
    dimmed ? styles.dimmed : null,
  ]}
>
  <LinearGradient
    colors={[...(isExpanded ? glass.elevated.gradient : glass.card.gradient)]}
    start={{ x: 0, y: 0 }}

    style={[styles.card, isExpanded ? styles.cardLit : styles.cardIdle]}

      ]}
      pointerEvents="none"
      accessibilityElementsHidden
      importantForAccessibility="no-hide-descendants"
    />
```

**The two states, resolved:**

| | Idle (collapsed) | Lit (expanded) |
|---|---|---|
| gradient LIGHT | `rgba(248,250,252,1) → rgba(241,245,249,1)` (`card`) | `rgba(255,255,255,1) → rgba(248,250,252,1)` (`elevated`) |
| gradient DARK | `rgba(14,57,101,0.85) → rgba(23,65,110,0.92)` | `rgba(23,65,110,0.88) → rgba(14,57,101,0.95)` |
| border LIGHT | `rgba(148,163,184,0.45)` (`glass.card.border`) | `#3b82f6` (`colors.primaryLight`) |
| border DARK | `rgba(28,78,132,0.5)` | `#4BA3D4` (`colors.primaryLight`) |
| highlightTop LIGHT | `rgba(148,163,184,0.45)` | `rgba(100,116,139,0.35)` |
| highlightTop DARK | `rgba(184,212,240,0.08)` | `rgba(184,212,240,0.12)` |
| shadow | `Layout.shadow.card[scheme]` | `primaryLight` glow, `{0,+4}`, opacity `0.35`, radius `12`, `elevation 6` |
| dimmed (any other card open) | `opacity: 0.5` | n/a |

**Full `StyleSheet.create` block, verbatim (ExportCaseCard.tsx:246-347):**

```js
const createStyles = (colors: ThemeColors, glass: GlassSet, scheme: ColorScheme) =>
  StyleSheet.create({
    wrapper: {
      borderRadius: Layout.borderRadius.lg,
      // Opaque background is REQUIRED for the shadow: without it iOS skips
      // the cheap shadowPath and pixel-rasterizes every card while scrolling
      // (Fabric's >0.999 alpha check reads THIS view's own backgroundColor —
      // the gradient sibling's alpha cannot satisfy it).
      // Dark-theme cost: this also blocks the grid backdrop from showing
      // through under cards (it was faintly visible pre-fix through the
      // α0.85–0.95 gradient); accepted — no composition keeps both.
      backgroundColor: colors.background,
    },
    // The canonical card elevation, not a fifth copy of it. The hand-rolled
    // version used pure `#000000` in BOTH themes; `Layout.shadow.card` switches
    // to a tinted `rgba(30,58,138,0.18)` in light, because neutral black over
    // white reads harsh and near-invisible at the same time.
    wrapperIdle: Layout.shadow.card[scheme],
    wrapperLit: {
      shadowColor: colors.primaryLight,
      shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 4 },
      shadowOpacity: 0.35,
      shadowRadius: 12,
      elevation: 6,
    },
    dimmed: {
      opacity: 0.5,
    },
    card: {
      borderRadius: Layout.borderRadius.lg,
      borderWidth: 1,
      padding: Layout.spacing.md,
      overflow: 'hidden',
    },
    cardIdle: {
      borderColor: glass.card.border,
    },
    cardLit: {
      borderColor: colors.primaryLight,
    },
    header: {
      flexDirection: 'row',
      alignItems: 'center',
    },
    headerPressable: {
      flex: 1,
      flexDirection: 'row',
      alignItems: 'center',
      marginLeft: Layout.spacing.xs,
    },
    pressed: {
      opacity: 0.7,
    },
    headerLeft: {
      flex: 1,
    },
    displayName: {
      fontSize: Typography.fontSize.base,
      color: colors.textSecondary,
    },
    caseNumber: {
      fontSize: Typography.fontSize.lg,
      fontWeight: Typography.fontWeight.bold,
      color: colors.text,
      marginBottom: Layout.spacing.xxs,
    },
    headerRight: {
      alignItems: 'flex-end',
      marginLeft: Layout.spacing.sm,
    },
    locationCount: {
      fontSize: Typography.fontSize.sm,
      color: colors.textSecondary,
      marginTop: Layout.spacing.xs,
    },
    highlight: {
      position: 'absolute',
      top: 0,
      left: 0,
      right: 0,
      height: 1,
      zIndex: 1,
    },
    chevron: {
      width: Layout.iconSize.xs,
      textAlign: 'center',
      marginLeft: Layout.spacing.xs,
    },
    locationsContainer: {
      marginTop: Layout.spacing.base,
      paddingTop: Layout.spacing.xs,
      borderTopWidth: 1,
      borderTopColor: glass.card.border,
    },
    noLocations: {
      fontSize: Typography.fontSize.sm,
      fontStyle: 'italic',
      color: colors.textTertiary,
      textAlign: 'center',
      paddingVertical: Layout.spacing.md,
    },
  })
```

Resolved: `wrapper.borderRadius` **12**, `backgroundColor: colors.background` (light `#ffffff`, dark `#002853`); `card` radius **12**, `borderWidth: 1`, `padding` **16**, `overflow:'hidden'`; `headerPressable.marginLeft` **4**; `pressed.opacity: 0.7`; `displayName` **16** / `textSecondary`; `caseNumber` **18** / `'700'` / `colors.text` / marginBottom **2**; `headerRight.marginLeft` **8**; `locationCount` **14** / `textSecondary` / marginTop **4**; `highlight` `height: 1` / `zIndex: 1`; `chevron.width: Layout.iconSize.xs` = **16**, marginLeft **4**; `locationsContainer` marginTop **12**, paddingTop **4**, 1px `glass.card.border` top rule; `noLocations` **14** / italic / `textTertiary` / centred / paddingVertical **16**.

```jsx

  name={isExpanded ? 'chevron-down' : 'chevron-forward'}
```

Body entrance (ExportCaseCard.tsx:105-116): `bodyRise.setValue(6)` then `Animated.timing(bodyRise, { toValue: 0, duration: 160, useNativeDriver: true })` — **transform-only**, translateY 6→0 over 160ms.

Status badge is `<CaseStatusBadge status={caseData.status} />` at default `medium` size (:182) — the only place in my scope that renders it at medium alongside a location count. **What it replaced.** Baseline (`git show d9606460:...`):

**Notes.** The wrapper/shadow argument (:119-124, :250-257) is the clearest statement in the campaign of why a hand-roll survives:
> *"Shadow lives on the WRAPPER, not the gradient: `card` needs overflow:'hidden' for the gradient's rounded corners, and on iOS masksToBounds clips the layer's OWN shadow (CSS box-shadow survives an element's overflow:hidden; UIKit doesn't — PR-91 MEDIUM)."*
> *"Opaque background is REQUIRED for the shadow: without it iOS skips the cheap shadowPath and pixel-rasterizes every card while scrolling (Fabric's >0.999 alpha check reads THIS view's own backgroundColor — the gradient sibling's alpha cannot satisfy it). Dark-theme cost: this also blocks the grid backdrop from showing through under cards (it was faintly visible pre-fix through the α0.85–0.95 gradient); accepted — no composition keeps both."*

The shadow-token note (:259-262): *"The canonical card elevation, not a fifth copy of it. The hand-rolled version used pure `#000000` in BOTH themes; `Layout.shadow.card` switches to a tinted `rgba(30,58,138,0.18)` in light, because neutral black over white reads harsh and near-invisible at the same time."*

Emphasis policy, file header (:5-10): *"Emphasis follows the OPEN case (operator amendment: lit-follows-open) ... Divergence edge accepted by the operator: an armed-but-collapsed case (operator armed A, then browsed B) is not lit — the footer still names the armed case and remains the export truth."*

A11y (:154-157): *"The tri-state checkbox is a SIBLING of the expand Pressable, not a descendant (PR-90 a11y MEDIUM): VoiceOver must focus it independently, and a disabled checkbox press must never fall through to expand/collapse."*

### The shared floating-header screen shell (applies to all three tab screens)

All three of my hosting screens converged on one shell. `Screen` and `OverlayHeader` / `MainHeader` live in `src/components/layout/` (another agent's files) — what follows is the **call-site contract** as written in my three screens, which is what a web replica has to reproduce.

```jsx
<Screen
  scrollable={false}
  padding={false}
  excludeBottomSafeArea={true}
  excludeTopSafeArea={true}
  keyboardAware={false}
  showGrid={true}
  showScanLine={true}
>
  <OverlayHeader onHeightChange={setHeaderHeight} scrollY={scrollY} testID="...">
    <MainHeader title="..." ... />
  </OverlayHeader>
  {/* list, whose ListHeaderComponent is a spacer of height headerHeight + Layout.spacing.md */}
</Screen>
```

Scroll plumbing, identical in all three (`home.tsx:53-56`, `cases.tsx:132-135`, `export.tsx:40-43`):

```js
const scrollY = useSharedValue(0)
const handleScroll = useAnimatedScrollHandler((event) => {
  scrollY.set(event.contentOffset.y)
})
```

**`excludeTopSafeArea={true}` is load-bearing, not a tweak.** `cases.tsx:1103-1106`: *"The floating header blurs the list, so the list must reach the physical top of the screen or its pixels stop existing at the inset line and the glass slices scrolled content off at a hard edge. `OverlayHeader` pads its own content down to compensate."* `home.tsx:360-362` and `export.tsx:190-192` both cross-reference that comment.

**The header spacer is `headerHeight + Layout.spacing.md` (= measured header + 16) in all three** — `cases.tsx:1140`, `home.tsx:281`, `ExportHub.tsx:211` (fed by `export.tsx:208`). `cases.tsx:1137-1139` records why: *"Clears the floating header. `sm` reproduces the gap the in-flow header's `marginBottom` used to provide, so the first card rests exactly where the trimmed flat header put it."* (The comment says `sm`; the code is `Layout.spacing.md`. The code is authoritative — **16**.)

All three are flagged EXPERIMENTAL with a named revert path (`cases.tsx:1112-1114`): *"the header floats and the list runs under it. Revert the commit that introduced `OverlayHeader` to get the flat in-flow header back — nothing inside `MainHeader` changed."*

The dispatch table (export.tsx:10-13, enforced at :165-172):

```
all N of N selected → handleExportZip         (full-case ZIP, incl. Case Map)
exactly 1 selected  → handleExportLocationZip (flat location ZIP v2.2)
2 ≤ k < N           → handleExportSubsetZip   (subset ZIP v2.3, partial-declaring)
```

with `isFullCaseSelection(selection, caseData.locations.length)` as THE predicate, shared with the footer copy in `ExportHub` (:119).

Selection semantics, worth porting exactly:
- **One-case rule** (:84-101): a toggle in a different case silently REPLACES the selection; *"the footer's case number is the indicator (§8.5)."*
- **Any** location-level toggle sets `armedFullCase: false`, *"even one that happens to complete the set by hand"* (:87-89). The case-level checkbox sets `armedFullCase: true` (:115).
- Selection is pruned against refreshed data (:62-76): dropped locations leave the set; an emptied set or a vanished case clears the selection; `armedFullCase` survives only while the selection still covers ALL of the armed case's current locations.
- Loud backstops on dispatch (:127-156) — `logError` + `Alert.alert` rather than a silent no-op, because *"On an evidence app a silently-dead CTA reads as success"* (:131).

**What it replaced.** The 67-line diff is the floating-header adoption (`headerHeight`, `scrollY`, `handleScroll`, `OverlayHeader`, `excludeTopSafeArea`, `contentTopInset`, `testID`s) plus the `void`-marking of the three dispatches. No styling existed here before or after.

**Notes.** `useFocusEffect(useCallback(() => { refresh() }, [refresh]))` (:52-56) — *"Tabs are lazy:false — re-query on focus to pick up changes made elsewhere."* Commit `5eea966b` made that focus refresh not raise the pull-to-refresh spinner (`refresh` vs `pullToRefresh` are distinct on `useCases`). All statuses are queried, default pagination — *"an archived case is exactly what a records request asks for (architecture §10)"* (:36-37).

#### The accuracy colour code — a genuine per-theme FORK

This is the one place in my scope where the two themes take structurally different token families. `CoordinateDisplay.tsx:73-89`:

```js
const accuracyRating =
  accuracy !== undefined
    ? getAccuracyRating(
        accuracy,
        isDark
          ? {
              success: colors.success,
              warning: colors.warning,
              error: colors.errorOnLight,
            }
          : {
              success: colors.successOnLight,
              warning: colors.warningOnLight,
              error: colors.errorOnLight,
            },
      )
    : null
```

Thresholds (`src/features/location/lib/accuracy-rating.ts:46-55`): `≤5 → Excellent (success)`, `≤10 → Good (success)`, `≤25 → Fair (warning)`, `>25 → Poor (error)`.

**Resolved rating → colour:**

| Rating | Threshold | LIGHT | DARK |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Excellent` | ≤5 m | `#065f46` `successOnLight` | `#10d177` `success` |
| `Good` | ≤10 m | `#065f46` `successOnLight` | `#10d177` `success` |
| `Fair` | ≤25 m | `#78350f` `warningOnLight` | `#ffd93d` `warning` |
| `Poor` | >25 m | `#991b1b` `errorOnLight` | `#f0f4f8` `errorOnLight` — **neutral, no red** |

**What it replaced.** Baseline styles (`git show d9606460:...`, lines 173-218):

```js
container: {
  padding: Layout.spacing.md,
  borderRadius: Layout.borderRadius.lg,
  borderWidth: 1,
  marginBottom: Layout.spacing.md,
},
```

with an **opaque `colors.card` fill plus its own drop shadow**, no gradient, no highlight strip. Also `icon: { fontSize: 16, marginRight: 6 }` — the icon was an **emoji text node**, not an `Ionicons` glyph; `coordinates: { fontSize: 14, fontWeight: '600', fontFamily: 'monospace' }` (raw); `metadataRow: { marginLeft: 22, gap: 6 }` (raw 22, hand-measured against the emoji); a `separator: { fontSize: 12 }` style for the two literal `|` nodes between the metadata fields; `accuracy` / `source` / `rating` at raw `fontSize: 12, fontWeight: '500'`. Baseline passed the SATURATED accents to `getAccuracyRating` in both themes.

**Notes — quoted in full, because both halves carry numbers.**

Surface, CoordinateDisplay.tsx:216-223:
> *"The wrapper clips the gradient to the nested tier's corner; the gradient paints the surface. This used to be an opaque `colors.card` rectangle with its own drop shadow, sitting inside a translucent glass `FormSection` - the same defect the campaign fixed on `dvr-information.tsx` and missed here. **It also made the passive readout the MOST elevated thing in the block, above the actionable capture button, inverting the hierarchy.** On the nested tier it now sits below the button's `elevated` surface, which is the right way round."*

The fork, CoordinateDisplay.tsx:55-72:
> *"Forked per scheme, because the two themes fail in opposite directions.*
> *LIGHT takes the measured `*OnLight` foregrounds (D8a). This is a LABEL on a surface, so it needs AA's 4.5:1, and the raw accents it used to pass measured **2.03 (Excellent/Good), 1.72 (Fair) and 3.01 (Poor)**.*
> *DARK cannot take them: all four dark `*OnLight` tokens are `#f0f4f8` (Colors.ts:189), so handing them over painted Excellent, Fair and Poor the same near-white as the body copy — **CIE76 dE 0.0 between all three**. That is the exact defect this batch exists to undo, and unlike `CaseStatusBadge` this row has no fill or border to carry the severity instead: the label IS the only carrier. Dark therefore uses the saturated accents, which clear AA on this ground (**success 5.20, warning 7.62**).*
> *`error` is the one cell that cannot be fixed: **NO red in the dark palette clears 4.5 here (error 3.15, errorDark 2.56, errorLight 1.64)**. Poor keeps the neutral foreground rather than shipping a sub-AA label, and the word "Poor" plus the metre reading carry it. Documented, not silently accepted."*

The `AccuracyForegrounds` type was renamed off `ThemeColors` for this reason (`accuracy-rating.ts:13-31`): *"Named `ThemeColors` originally, which let a call site pass three foregrounds under fill-token names and still type-check. ... This type says "a colour per severity that is legible on the ground you are painting"; it does not promise they came from the same ramp."*

Two test-stability notes worth porting as rendering rules — :165-170 and :186-189: the coordinates and the accuracy are each **one interpolated string**, not multiple text nodes, because *"as separate nodes the rendered children array is formatting-dependent (prettier wrapping the line turns ", " into "," + " "), which is invisible on screen but changes what tests observe."* And :175-178: the two literal `|` separator nodes are **gone** — *"three data points padded out to five text nodes was the row's biggest noise source, and the container already declares a `gap`."*

- **`PrimaryButtonGradient` — NOT CONSUMED. The brief's expectation is wrong.** A repo-wide grep (`grep -rn "PrimaryButtonGradient" src/ app/ --include=*.tsx --include=*.ts`, excluding `__tests__`) returns exactly three hits: `src/constants/Colors.ts:471` (the definition) and `src/components/common/Button.tsx:16` + `:281` (the sole consumer). `GpsCaptureControl` takes **`GlassColors[colorScheme].elevated`** for its fill instead — it is a glass capture control, not a primary CTA. The `PrimaryButtonGradient` docblock (Colors.ts:451-453) still names GpsCaptureControl as its second consumer — **that comment is stale at `main`**; the de-duplication that actually landed shared `ElevatedEdges`, not the gradient.

**Role:** The shared "Use Current Location" row — a raised glass capture button plus a compact labelled reverse-geocode `Switch`, with inline capture errors underneath. Two consumers: `IncidentLocationForm` (forces `'precise'`) and `LocationForm` (settings default).

**Canonical recipe NOW.**

Tier (GpsCaptureControl.tsx:74): `const glass = GlassColors[colorScheme].elevated` — **note: no `?? 'light'` fallback; `2b60f679` deleted the dead fallbacks.**

The button surface (GpsCaptureControl.tsx:111-122) — this is the complete recipe:

```jsx
<LinearGradient
  colors={glass.gradient}
  style={[
    styles.button,
    {
      borderColor: glass.border,
      borderTopColor: ElevatedEdges[colorScheme].top,
      borderBottomColor: ElevatedEdges[colorScheme].bottom,
    },
    Layout.shadow.card[colorScheme],
  ]}
>
```

**`ElevatedEdges` definition** (`src/constants/Colors.ts:487-490`):

```ts
export const ElevatedEdges = {
  light: { top: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35)', bottom: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)' },
  dark: { top: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14)', bottom: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)' },
} as const
```

**Fully resolved button, LIGHT:**
- gradient `rgba(255,255,255,1) → rgba(248,250,252,1)` (default `LinearGradient` direction — **no `start`/`end` props are passed here**)
- `borderColor: rgba(100,116,139,0.35)`, overridden on top by `rgba(255,255,255,0.35)` and on bottom by `rgba(0,0,0,0.1)`
- shadow `rgba(30,58,138,0.18)`, offset `{0,3}`, opacity `1`, radius `8`, `elevation 4`

**Fully resolved button, DARK:**
- gradient `rgba(23,65,110,0.88) → rgba(14,57,101,0.95)`
- `borderColor: rgba(43,140,193,0.25)`, top `rgba(255,255,255,0.14)`, bottom `rgba(0,0,0,0.3)`
- shadow `#000`, offset `{0,4}`, opacity `0.15`, radius `8`, `elevation 4`

Icon (GpsCaptureControl.tsx:132-136): `<Ionicons name="locate-outline" size={18} color={isDark ? colors.primaryLight : colors.primary} />` — **size 18 raw (off the `Layout.iconSize` scale)**; colour dark `#4BA3D4`, light `#1e3a8a`. Busy state (:125): `<ActivityIndicator size="small" color={colors.primary} />`.

**Full `StyleSheet.create` block, verbatim (GpsCaptureControl.tsx:166-220):**

```js
const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: {
    marginTop: Layout.spacing.sm,
    // The control had a leading margin and no trailing one, so whatever follows
    // it butted straight against the button. On the Submission screen that is
    // `CoordinateDisplay`, and the two read as one squashed block. Owned here
    // rather than by the consumer: this is the control's own rhythm, and all
    // three consumers were paying the same gap.
    marginBottom: Layout.spacing.md,
  },
  row: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    gap: Layout.spacing.md,
  },
  buttonWrap: {
    flex: 1,
  },
  button: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',

    borderWidth: 1,
    // Fixed height fits a two-line label, so the button doesn't shrink when

    // single-line states centre vertically — no layout bump.
    minHeight: 60,
  },
  buttonText: {
    fontSize: Typography.fontSize.sm,
    // One weight, both themes. The dark-only bump to 600 was part of the same

    fontWeight: Typography.fontWeight.semibold,
    flexShrink: 1,
    textAlign: 'center',
  },
  toggle: {
    alignItems: 'center',
    gap: Layout.spacing.xxs,
  },
  toggleLabel: {
    fontSize: 11,
    fontWeight: Typography.fontWeight.semibold,
    textTransform: 'uppercase',
    letterSpacing: 0.3,
  },
  errorText: {
    fontSize: Typography.fontSize.xs,
    marginTop: Layout.spacing.xs,
  },
})
```

Resolved: `container` marginTop **8**, marginBottom **16**; `row.gap` **16**; `button` gap **8**, paddingVertical **12**, paddingHorizontal **16**, `borderRadius: Layout.borderRadius.control` = **10**, `borderWidth: 1`, `minHeight: 60` (raw); `buttonText` **14** / `'600'` / `flexShrink: 1` / centred, colour inline `colors.text`; `toggle.gap` **2**; `toggleLabel` **11** (raw, off-scale) / `'600'` / uppercase / `letterSpacing: 0.3` (raw), colour inline `colors.textSecondary`; `errorText` **12** / marginTop **4**, colour inline `colors.error` (light `#ef4444`, dark `#ff4757`).

Labels: toggle caption is the literal `Geocode` (:147); button label comes from the `label` prop — `Use Current Location (Highest Accuracy)` from `IncidentLocationForm`, `Use Current Location` from `LocationForm`. Busy text (:87): `Capturing…` while capturing, `Looking up address…` while reverse-geocoding. Button `numberOfLines={2}` for the label, `numberOfLines={1}` for busy text.

**What it replaced.** `git show d9606460:...GpsCaptureControl.tsx`:

- `const glass = GlassColors[colorScheme ?? 'light'].nestedCard` — the **RECESSED-reading nested tier**, on a control that is the block's primary action.
- `<LinearGradient colors={glass.gradient} style={[styles.button, { borderColor: glass.border }]}>` — **no `ElevatedEdges`, no `Layout.shadow.card`**: flat, unlit, unshadowed.
- `button: { gap: 8, paddingVertical: 12, paddingHorizontal: 16, borderRadius: 10, borderWidth: StyleSheet.hairlineWidth, minHeight: 60 }` — raw literals and a **hairline** border (now a full `1`).
- `buttonText: { fontSize: 14, fontWeight: '500' }` — weight **500**, now **600**.
- `Ionicons name="locate-outline" size={18} color={colors.primary}` — no dark fork to `primaryLight`.
- `toggle: { gap: 2 }`, `errorText: { fontSize: 12, marginTop: 4 }` — raw.
- `container: { marginTop: Layout.spacing.sm }` — **no `marginBottom` at all**.
- Icons imported as `import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons'` (barrel) rather than the subpath `'@expo/vector-icons/Ionicons'`.

Between baseline and `main` an intermediate state existed: `68f4e18a` introduced a module constant `GPS_GRADIENT_DARK` (a hand-mixed navy pair `['#234c7a','#113b68']`) which `54635255` deleted. That is the state the current in-file comment describes.

**Notes — the Phase 1 de-duplication argument, GpsCaptureControl.tsx:61-73:**
> *"ONE surface for both themes, which is the point of this row. The comment that used to sit above `GPS_GRADIENT_DARK` said the button "mirrors Button.tsx's depth recipe" and then hand-mixed two navies for dark while light quietly fell through to `nestedCard`, a **RECESSED** tier: one component, two structurally different surfaces, and only one of them pressable-looking.*
> *`elevated` is that recipe as a token. In dark its stops (rgba(23,65,110,0.88) -> rgba(14,57,101,0.95)) land within a few points of the deleted `['#234c7a','#113b68']`, so this is close to a no-op there; in light it is the visible half of the fix, replacing a recessed wash with a raised white surface. The lit-top and grounded-bottom edges now come from `ElevatedEdges`, shared with `Button` rather than a second copy that had already drifted (**0.16/0.35 against Button's 0.14/0.30**)."*

`ElevatedEdges`' own docblock (Colors.ts:477-485): *"The lit-top / grounded-bottom edge pair that turns a flat gradient into a raised, pressable surface. Shared by `Button`'s primary variant and `GpsCaptureControl`, which each carried their own near-identical copy (0.14/0.30 vs 0.16/0.35) before this. **Deliberately white and black rather than theme tokens: these are specular highlight and cast shadow, which are the light source and its absence, not palette colours.**"*

Rhythm fix (:169-173): *"The control had a leading margin and no trailing one, so whatever follows it butted straight against the button. On the Submission screen that is `CoordinateDisplay`, and the two read as one squashed block."*

`Layout.shadow.dialog`'s docblock explicitly records the audit of this file (`Layout.ts:148-156`): *"`GpsCaptureControl` took `card` when Phase 1 converted it. Verify the surface before reaching for this."*

**For completeness — `PrimaryButtonGradient`** (`src/constants/Colors.ts:471-474`), since a web replica will need it for `Button` even though this file does not use it:

```ts
export const PrimaryButtonGradient = {
  light: ['#2563eb', '#1d3584'],
  dark: [Colors.dark.primaryDark, '#17527A'],   // ['#1F6B99', '#17527A']
} as const
```

Docblock measurements (Colors.ts:455-469), with `onPrimary` `#ffffff` at 16px semibold: *"dark #1F6B99 -> **5.80:1**, #17527A -> **8.32:1**; light #2563eb -> **5.17:1**, #1d3584 -> **11.08:1**. Do NOT lighten either dark stop and do NOT "tokenise" the light pair to `[primaryLight, primaryDark]`. The shipped dark recipe `['#35A0D6','#2580AD']` measured **2.94:1** at its worst against white, and the proposed light swap takes a passing 5.17 down to **3.68**. On a blue gradient the two candidate label colours move in OPPOSITE directions, so the label is fixed first and the gradient tuned to it."*

```js
const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  backdrop: {
    position: 'absolute',
    top: 0,
    left: 0,
    right: 0,
    bottom: 0,
    zIndex: Z_INDEX.backdrop,

```

`Layout.ts:151-153` records the deliberate decision NOT to give this panel the `dialog` shadow: *"`AutocompleteSuggestionList` is a panel anchored 4px under its input, not a floating modal, and took `card` (a 28-40px radius at elevation 24 under a dropdown would read as a bug)."*

### `location/constants/index.ts` — `src/features/location/constants/index.ts`

**Status:** CHANGED (129 lines; `git diff --stat` `13 ++-` — formatting + one prettier-driven signature wrap)
**Phase/PR:** `d1739700 style: adopt prettier and reformat (886 files)` (plus `d8d407ba test(constants): delete the 13 partial design-token mocks, guard with invariant 7`, which touched tests not this file)

**Role:** Mapbox endpoint/rate-limit config, GPS accuracy modes, coordinate precision, and geocoding timeouts. **No colour, no styling.**

**Values a web replica needs:**

```ts
MAPBOX_CONFIG.endpoints = {                                            // :18-23
  suggest:  'https://api.mapbox.com/search/searchbox/v1/suggest',
  retrieve: 'https://api.mapbox.com/search/searchbox/v1/retrieve',
  reverse:  'https://api.mapbox.com/search/geocode/v6/reverse',
  forward:  'https://api.mapbox.com/search/searchbox/v1/forward',
}
MAPBOX_CONFIG.defaults = {                                             // :24-30
  language: 'en', limit: 5, types: 'address,place',
  debounceMs: 300, minQueryLength: 3,
}
MAPBOX_CONFIG.rateLimit = { maxRequestsPerSecond: 10, retryDelayMs: 100 }  // :31-34

GPS_CONFIG_STATIC = { maxAttempts: 10, retryDelay: 500 }               // :40-43

ACCURACY_MODE_CONFIG = {                                               // :51-55
  quick:    { targetAccuracy: 100 },
  balanced: { targetAccuracy: 50 },
  precise:  { targetAccuracy: 10 },
}

PRECISE_GPS_CONFIG = {                                                 // :75-80
  targetAccuracy: 10, maxAttempts: 10, timeout: 120000, retryDelay: 500,
}

COORDINATE_CONFIG = { decimalPlaces: 6 }                               // :108-110

GEOCODING_CONSTANTS = {                                                // :115-127
  FORWARD_GEOCODE_TIMEOUT_MS: 8_000,
  PROXIMITY_CACHE_AGE_MS: 5 * 60 * 1_000,      // 5 minutes
  PROXIMITY_CAPTURE_TIMEOUT_MS: 5_000,
  PROXIMITY_CACHE_TTL_MS: 10 * 60 * 1_000,     // 10 minutes
}
```

`COORDINATE_CONFIG.decimalPlaces: 6` is what `CoordinateDisplay` formats with — the in-file note (:109) says *"Standard precision for GPS coordinates (approximately 0.11m accuracy)"*. Note `GEOJSON_CONFIG.COORDINATE_PRECISION` in the case-management constants is also `6`; they agree but are separate constants.

**What it replaced.** Only whitespace. `buildOverrideConfig`'s return type was re-wrapped by prettier (:96-103). No value changed.

**Notes.** `GpsAccuracyOverride` is deliberately narrower than `GpsAccuracyMode` (:82-89):
> *"The subset of GpsAccuracyMode that functions as a per-capture GPS override. Only 'precise' bypasses the user's settings default — 'balanced'/'quick' are settings-only modes, so the override surfaces (buildOverrideConfig, the useGpsCapture `capture` arg, GpsCaptureControl's `accuracyOverride`) do NOT accept them; passing them would silently no-op."*

### Cross-cutting notes for whoever maps this onto the demo

1. **The status badge is the single most reusable thing here.** One component, six call sites, three sizes, and a fill+border+text triple that is fully determined by `(status, theme)`. Everything else in the feature that shows status defers to it — `DashboardCaseCard`'s uppercase local badge and `map-view`'s `STATUS_SEVERITY` were both folded in.
2. **Dark mode carries status in the fill and border, never the foreground.** All four dark `*OnLight` tokens are `#f0f4f8`. Any web replica that maps "severity → text colour" will silently reproduce the exact defect this campaign undid.
3. **Three depth tiers, and the corner is not the tier.** `card` (top-level, radius 12), `nestedCard` (radius 12 for nested CARDS, radius 8 for nested ROWS), `elevated` (modals, pageSheet headers, the GPS button). D13(a) governs the ROW/CARD split; `Card` hard-pins `lg` and the four hand-rolled rows exist solely to express `md`.
4. **Every shadow in scope is `Layout.shadow.card[scheme]`** except `ExportCaseCard`'s lit state (a `primaryLight` glow) and `TimelineItem`'s marker glow. Light is tinted `rgba(30,58,138,0.18)` at full opacity; dark is `#000` at 0.15.
5. **Six local error-callout recipes were deleted** and replaced by `<Banner severity="error">` — in `NewCaseModal`, `NewLocationModal`, `EditIncidentLocationModal`, `ExportHub`, `home.tsx`, and one more outside my scope. Every one of them had `colors.error` as the only severity signal at sub-AA contrast. The remaining `style` props on those sites are **layout only** (`marginBottom`).
6. **Saturated accents survive only as non-text marks**: the timeline marker, the trash icon, the `ExportHub` artifact line (which is a mono caption, and the one debatable survivor), and `LocationPill`'s dot — the last of which was moved to `successDark` / `infoDark` / `warningAccent` to clear WCAG 1.4.11's 3:1.
7. **Four off-scale font sizes remain**, all knowingly: `10` (`DashboardCaseCard.badgeNumber`, marked `ponytail:` and assigned to Phase 13), `11` (`GpsCaptureControl.toggleLabel`), `13` and `15` (`AutocompleteSuggestionList`). Also `13` in `ExportLocationRow.indicatorMark`.
8. **The brief's two verification asks resolved as:** `SwipeDeleteAction` → `DangerFill` **CONFIRMED** (Colors.ts:510-513, applied at SwipeDeleteAction.tsx:105); `GpsCaptureControl` → `ElevatedEdges` **CONFIRMED** (:117-118) but `PrimaryButtonGradient` **NOT USED** — `Button.tsx` is its only consumer, and the `PrimaryButtonGradient` docblock naming GpsCaptureControl is stale at `main`.
9. **`case-management/constants/index.ts` holds no status theming** and never did. The theming is `CaseStatusBadge.tsx` (selection) + `src/constants/Colors.ts` (tokens).

### `FormSection` — `src/components/form/FormSection.tsx`

**Status:** CHANGED (one rendered change; the rest is prettier + a dead-fallback deletion)
**Phase/PR:** `2b60f679` refactor(components): delete the dead colorScheme fallbacks in the shared library · `91c98ed2` refactor(design-system): read the card shadow from Layout.shadow.card · `d1739700` prettier

**Role:** The wizard's section-card recipe — a titled group of form fields, optionally collapsible, optionally rendered as a glass card. Every wizard screen composes its content out of these.

**Canonical recipe NOW.** Props (`FormSection.tsx:23-40`): `title: string`, `children`, `collapsible?: boolean = false`, `defaultCollapsed?: boolean = false`, `required?: boolean = false`, `testID?`, `glass?: boolean = false`, `glassVariant?: GlassVariant = 'card'`.

Structure:
- Header (`:74-86`) — `<View style={[styles.header, { borderBottomColor: glass ? 'transparent' : colors.border }]}>`. Title `<Text style={[styles.title, { color: colors.text }]}>` with, when `required`, a trailing `<Text style={[styles.required, { color: colors.error }]}> *</Text>`. When `collapsible`, an indicator `<Text style={[styles.indicator, { color: colors.textSecondary }]}>` showing `'+'` collapsed / `'−'` (U+2212 MINUS SIGN) expanded.
- Collapsible header is wrapped in `TouchableOpacity activeOpacity={0.7} accessibilityRole="button" accessibilityLabel={`${title} section, ${isCollapsed ? 'collapsed' : 'expanded'}`} accessibilityHint="Double tap to expand or collapse"` (`:92-100`). Toggle runs `LayoutAnimation.configureNext(LayoutAnimation.Presets.easeInEaseOut)` (`:70`).
- Empty-section collapse (`:114-120`): `if (React.Children.toArray(children).length === 0) return null` — a section whose every field is gated off by Form Customization renders nothing, not an empty titled box.
- Shadow (`:111-112`): `const isLightMode = colorScheme === 'light'; const shadowStyle: ViewStyle = Layout.shadow.card[isLightMode ? 'light' : 'dark']`.
- Glass branch (`:123-140`): `const glassStyle = GlassColors[colorScheme][glassVariant]`, then
```tsx
<View style={[styles.glassContainer, shadowStyle]} testID={testID}>
  <View style={[styles.highlight, { backgroundColor: glassStyle.highlightTop }]} />
  <LinearGradient
    colors={[...glassStyle.gradient]}
    start={{ x: 0, y: 0 }}
    end={{ x: 0, y: 1 }}
    style={[styles.glassGradient, { borderColor: glassStyle.border }]}
  >
    {sectionContent}
  </LinearGradient>
</View>
```
- Non-glass branch (`:143-147`): `<View style={styles.container} testID={testID}>{sectionContent}</View>`.

`StyleSheet.create` VERBATIM (`FormSection.tsx:150-200`):
```ts
const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: {
    marginBottom: Layout.spacing.lg,
  },
  // Glass container - shadow styles applied dynamically based on theme
  glassContainer: {
    position: 'relative',
    marginBottom: Layout.spacing.lg,
    borderRadius: Layout.borderRadius.lg,
    overflow: 'hidden',
  },
  // Top highlight edge for glass
  highlight: {
    position: 'absolute',
    top: 0,
    left: 0,
    right: 0,
    height: 1,
    zIndex: 1,
  },
  // Glass gradient background
  glassGradient: {
    borderRadius: Layout.borderRadius.lg,
    borderWidth: 1,
    padding: Layout.spacing.md,
  },
  header: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    justifyContent: 'space-between',
    alignItems: 'center',
    paddingBottom: Layout.spacing.sm,
    borderBottomWidth: 1,
    marginBottom: Layout.spacing.md,
  },
  title: {
    fontSize: Typography.fontSize.lg,
    fontWeight: Typography.fontWeight.semibold,
  },
  required: {
    fontSize: Typography.fontSize.lg,
  },
  indicator: {
    fontSize: Typography.fontSize['2xl'],
    fontWeight: Typography.fontWeight.bold,
    width: 24,
    textAlign: 'center',
  },
  content: {
    marginTop: Layout.spacing.sm,
  },
})
```

Literal resolution for a demo port: container `margin-bottom: 24px`; glass container `border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden` + the theme card shadow; highlight `height: 1px` absolutely positioned across the top at `z-index: 1`; gradient `border-radius: 12px; border-width: 1px; padding: 16px`; header `padding-bottom: 8px; border-bottom-width: 1px; margin-bottom: 16px` (border transparent under glass, `colors.border` otherwise); title `18px / 600`; indicator `24px / 700`, `width: 24px`, centred; content `margin-top: 8px`.

**What it replaced:** the shadow was a `useMemo`'d inline literal pair (`git show d9606460:src/components/form/FormSection.tsx`):
```ts
const shadowStyle: ViewStyle = useMemo(() => isLightMode
  ? { shadowColor: 'rgba(30, 58, 138, 0.18)', shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 3 }, shadowOpacity: 1, shadowRadius: 8, elevation: 4 }
  : { shadowColor: '#000', shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 4 }, shadowOpacity: 0.15, shadowRadius: 8, elevation: 4 }, [isLightMode])
```
Byte-identical to `Layout.shadow.card` — **no rendered change**, the values just moved to the token. The other change is `GlassColors[colorScheme ?? 'light']` → `GlassColors[colorScheme]` (dead fallback; `colorScheme` is non-nullable). Everything else in the diff is prettier line-joining.

**Notes:** in-file comment at `:109-110` — "Theme-aware shadow: more prominent in light mode for definition. A frozen constant, so no useMemo is needed to keep the reference stable." In-file comment at `:114-117` explains the Form-Customization empty collapse. No copy changes. Guarded by `src/components/form/__tests__/FormSection.test.tsx` + `__snapshots__/FormSection.test.tsx.snap`.

### `TimePicker.styles` — `src/components/form/TimeWheelPicker/TimePicker.styles.ts`

**Status:** CHANGED — the ~200-line loss is real and explained below
**Phase/PR:** `70b0da0f` correct six stale dE figures · `fb14d6b1` re-anchor the recessed well onto the ramp, and flatten it properly · `ad62ecb2` spacing tokens · `efb2cbc3` font weights + 'monospace' through Typography · `f4b45540` exact-match font sizes through Typography.fontSize · `069e0faa` border radii through Layout.borderRadius · `becba056` footer on shared Button · `bbb227a3` retire the four competing dark navies for GlassColors.sheet · `8abe15e9` extract withAlpha · `68f4e18a` badge-blue recolor base · `d1739700` prettier · `2f086078` eslint --fix

**Where the ~200 lines went — three things:**
1. **The four footer-button style keys were deleted outright** (`confirmButton`, `confirmButtonText`, `cancelButton`, `cancelButtonText` — ~95 lines with their comments), because `TimePicker.tsx` now uses the shared `<Button>`. The interface at `:74-87` says so explicitly: "No footer button keys. The Confirm/Cancel pair is `<Button variant="primary">` / `<Button variant="secondary">` now, so its recipe lives in that component, and the four keys this interface used to declare have nothing to describe."
2. **The local `hexToRgba` helper (~25 lines) was deleted**, replaced by imported `withAlpha` / `flattenOver` from `@/lib/utils/with-alpha` (`:31`).
3. **Every hand-rolled `isDark ? 'rgba(...)' : 'rgba(...)'` ternary collapsed to a single token expression** — the drum ground, the label pill, the container border trio, the item-container tint and divider. That is where the remaining line loss comes from.

Yes — the drum did move onto `GlassColors.recessed` composited over `GlassColors.sheet`.

**Canonical recipe NOW.**

Ground derivation (`:62-65`):
```ts
function getDrumBackground(colorScheme: ColorScheme): string {
  const glass = GlassColors[colorScheme]
  return flattenOver(glass.recessed.gradient[0], glass.sheet.gradient[0])
}
```
i.e. light: `rgba(203,213,225,0.45)` flattened over `rgba(255,255,255,1)`; dark: `rgba(0,24,50,0.6)` flattened over `rgba(0,40,83,0.98)`.

Row height constant (`:112`): `const PICKER_ITEM_HEIGHT = 45`.

`getPickerStyles(colors, colorScheme)` returned object, VERBATIM (`TimePicker.styles.ts:138-281`), comments included because they carry the measurements:
```ts
export function getPickerStyles(colors: ThemeColors, colorScheme: ColorScheme): PickerStyles {
  const isDark = colorScheme === 'dark'

  const modalBg = getDrumBackground(colorScheme)
  const recessed = GlassColors[colorScheme].recessed

  return {
    // Pass theme mode to library
    theme: colorScheme,

    // Modal background -- the library uses this as the base for gradient colors.
    // MUST match pickerContainer.backgroundColor exactly.
    backgroundColor: modalBg,

    // Text styles for picker values
    text: {
      color: colors.text,
    },

    pickerItem: {
      fontSize: Typography.fontSize['2xl'],
      // `colors.text` in both schemes. The dark branch's `#e8f0f8` was a
      // hand-mixed near-miss of `Colors.dark.text` (`#f0f4f8`), two points of
      // blue apart and reachable through the theme.
      color: colors.text,
      fontWeight: Typography.fontWeight.semibold,
      letterSpacing: 1.0,
      fontVariant: ['tabular-nums'],
      ...(isDark
        ? {
            textShadowColor: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6)',
            textShadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 1.5 },
            textShadowRadius: 3,
          }
        : {
            textShadowColor: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08)',
            textShadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 1 },
            textShadowRadius: 2,
          }),
    },

    pickerLabel: {
      fontSize: 11,
      // Flat `textSecondary`. Both literals were alpha-dimmed copies of it
      // (dark `153,186,221` IS `textSecondary`; light `107,114,128` was its
      // pre-Phase-9 value), and the dimming took an 11px label below AA on the
      // pill this style paints behind it: 3.08:1 dark and 2.20:1 light. The
      // flat token measures 8.41 dark / 6.75 light on the same ground.
      color: colors.textSecondary,
      fontWeight: Typography.fontWeight.semibold,
      letterSpacing: 0.8,
      // Was `rgba(4, 48, 92, 0.6)` in dark -- '#04305c' again, in rgba
      // clothing, and therefore the SAME colour as the drum it was meant to
      // stand out from, so the pill was invisible. Anchoring it on
      // `colors.background` (lighter than the recessed well in both themes)
      // is what finally delivers the "engraved marker" this comment claims.
      backgroundColor: withAlpha(colors.background, isDark ? 0.6 : 0.7),
      paddingHorizontal: Layout.spacing.xs,
      paddingVertical: Layout.spacing.xxs,
      borderRadius: Layout.borderRadius.sm,
      overflow: 'hidden',
    },

    // Label positioning -- snug against the number columns
    pickerLabelContainer: {
      right: -20,
      top: 0,
      bottom: 0,
    },

    pickerContainer: {
      backgroundColor: modalBg,
      marginRight: 0,
      justifyContent: 'center',
      alignItems: 'center',
      borderRadius: Layout.borderRadius.lg,
      paddingHorizontal: 10,
      gap: Layout.spacing.xsm,
      overflow: 'hidden',
      borderWidth: 1,
      // `recessed.highlightTop` carries a DARK value by design (see Colors.ts):
      // a well's top edge is in shadow, not catching light. That is exactly
      // what these three hand-rolled black alphas were approximating.
      borderColor: recessed.border,
      borderTopColor: recessed.highlightTop,
      borderBottomColor: recessed.highlightTop,
      ...(isDark
        ? {
            shadowColor: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)',
            shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 8 },
            shadowOpacity: 0.5,
            shadowRadius: 32,
            elevation: 8,
          }
        : {
            shadowColor: withAlpha(colors.primary, 0.08),
            shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 4 },
            shadowOpacity: 1,
            shadowRadius: 24,
            elevation: 6,
          }),
    },

    pickerItemContainer: {
      width: 90,
      height: PICKER_ITEM_HEIGHT,
      // The selection band's tint and the column divider. Both dark values were
      // `Colors.dark.primary` written as an rgb triple; the light band used the
      // SAME dark-theme triple, which is why the band reads cyan on white.
      backgroundColor: withAlpha(colors.primary, isDark ? 0.08 : 0.05),
      borderRightWidth: 1,
      borderRightColor: withAlpha(isDark ? colors.primary : colors.border, isDark ? 0.12 : 0.6),
    },

    // Gradient overlay -- the library positions this absolutely over the scroll content.
    // No extra styling needed here; the gradient props handle the visual effect.
    pickerGradientOverlay: {},
  }
}
```

`getGradientOverlayProps` VERBATIM (`:317-350`) — the 13-stop drum-curvature gradient:
```ts
export function getGradientOverlayProps(colorScheme: ColorScheme): GradientOverlayProps {
  const isDark = colorScheme === 'dark'
  const modalBg = getDrumBackground(colorScheme)

  const bgFull = withAlpha(modalBg, 1.0)                        // Fully opaque (edge hidden)
  const bgNearFull = withAlpha(modalBg, 0.96)                   // Extreme outer: almost hidden
  const bgHeavy = withAlpha(modalBg, 0.82)                      // Outer items: heavily faded
  const bgMid = withAlpha(modalBg, isDark ? 0.65 : 0.6)         // Steep ramp zone
  const bgBandOuter = withAlpha(modalBg, isDark ? 0.28 : 0.25)  // Just outside selection band
  const bgBandEdge = withAlpha(modalBg, isDark ? 0.1 : 0.08)    // Selection band edge: nearly clear
  const bgClear = withAlpha(modalBg, 0.0)                       // Dead center: fully clear

  return {
    colors: [bgFull, bgNearFull, bgHeavy, bgMid, bgBandOuter, bgBandEdge, bgClear,
             bgBandEdge, bgBandOuter, bgMid, bgHeavy, bgNearFull, bgFull],
    locations: [0.0, 0.08, 0.18, 0.24, 0.34, 0.4, 0.5, 0.6, 0.66, 0.76, 0.82, 0.92, 1.0],
  }
}
```

**What it replaced** (`git show d9606460:…/TimePicker.styles.ts`), concretely:
- Ground: `const modalBg = isDark ? '#0f2035' : colors.background`. Hard-coded navy.
- `pickerItem`: `fontSize: 24` (raw), `color: isDark ? '#e8f0f8' : colors.text`, `fontWeight: '600'` (raw).
- `pickerLabel`: `color: isDark ? 'rgba(153, 186, 221, 0.50)' : 'rgba(107, 114, 128, 0.60)'`, `backgroundColor: isDark ? 'rgba(15, 32, 53, 0.6)' : 'rgba(241, 245, 249, 0.7)'`, `paddingHorizontal: 4`, `paddingVertical: 2`, `borderRadius: 4` (all raw).
- `pickerContainer`: `borderRadius: 12`, `gap: 6` (raw); `borderColor: isDark ? 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4)' : 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)'`; `borderTopColor` / `borderBottomColor: isDark ? 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.30)' : 'rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.35)'`; light shadow `'rgba(30, 58, 138, 0.08)'`.
- `pickerItemContainer`: `backgroundColor: isDark ? 'rgba(43, 140, 193, 0.08)' : 'rgba(43, 140, 193, 0.05)'` (both the DARK primary — the light band literally rendered dark-theme cyan on white); `borderRightColor: isDark ? 'rgba(43, 140, 193, 0.12)' : 'rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.15)'`.
- The four deleted footer keys, verbatim from baseline:

```ts
    : { shadowColor: colors.primary, shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 2 }, shadowOpacity: 0.3, shadowRadius: 6, elevation: 3 }),
```

**Notes / quoted measurements** (docblock `:35-61`):
- "This used to read `withAlpha(recessed.gradient[0], 1)`, which is NOT flattening: it discards the alpha and returns the raw triple. … the drum shipped at `#060c16`, **27.77 CIE76 dE** from its own sheet, reading as a near-black slab. `flattenOver` composites it properly; on the retuned token that resolves to a navy **7.87 dE** from the sheet, which is a well."
- "Replaces the hand-rolled `#04305c`, which was a fourth competing dark navy rendering *inside* `GlassBottomSheet`'s (`#0f2035`) — a visible two-tone block in the app's most-used picker."
- "Flattened over the sheet's UPPER stop specifically … the dropdown next door composites the same token live over the same region. Using the same stop is what keeps the two pickers' grounds identical rather than merely similar."
- Label pill: 3.08:1 dark / 2.20:1 light before, 8.41 dark / 6.75 light after.
No user-facing copy in this file.

```ts
  // to a warning-coloured left rule so the text can be `colors.text` (16.19:1
  // light / 9.70:1 dark). The rule only reinforces the "DST +1hr" already
  // spelled out in the header, so it is not a sole information carrier.
  dstTimeSection: {
    borderLeftWidth: 3,
    paddingLeft: Layout.spacing.sm,
  },
  timeSectionHeader: {
    fontSize: Typography.fontSize.sm,
    fontWeight: Typography.fontWeight.bold,
    …
  },
  // The corrected DVR-to-real-time values: this screen's primary output …
  // They rendered in `colors.primary`, which is a mid-tone fill being used as
  // body text: 2.81:1 in dark mode, failing AA 4.5:1 at 16px bold, and failing
  // even against the bare screen background (3.94:1). Every accent token in the
  // palette fails at least one theme on this surface; only `colors.text` clears
  // both. Same "text carries, colour reinforces" call this screen already made
  // for the DST callout.
  timeValueAdjusted: {
    fontSize: Typography.fontSize.base,
    fontWeight: Typography.fontWeight.bold,
    …
  },
  dstNotification: {
    marginTop: Layout.spacing.md,
  },
```

**What it replaced:**
- Heading ladder: `sectionHeader` was `lg` / `bold` (18px/700); `scopeTitle` was `base` / `bold` (16px/700).
- The DST callout was a dashed outline card, now deleted:
```ts
dstNotificationCard: { marginTop: Layout.spacing.md, padding: Layout.spacing.md, borderWidth: 1, borderStyle: 'dashed' },
dstNotificationText: { fontSize: Typography.fontSize.sm, fontStyle: 'italic', textAlign: 'center' },
```
rendered as `<Card style={[styles.dstNotificationCard, { borderColor: notification.type === 'warning' ? colors.warning : colors.primary }]}>` with the message text in the same accent.
- `resultCard` / `scopeCard` were `<Card … glass>` (default `card` variant), so nested cards used the same gradient as their parent section.
- OCR row icon+label were `colors.primary`.
- The DST block was `<View style={styles.timeSection}>` with header and both values in `colors.warning`.

**Notes:** rulings cited in-file — **DEF-UI-012** (heading ladder), **DEF-UI-018** (Button non-string children → `colors.link`), **D13(a)** (nesting, per the commit subject `7216e1a1`), **F1** / **F115-3** / **F3** review findings. Quoted ratios: 2.81:1 (dark `primary` as body text), 3.94:1 (dark `primary` on bare background), 2.05:1 (light `warning` on the glass card), 16.19:1 light / 9.70:1 dark for `colors.text` on the same ground. **No user-facing copy changed** — the four DST scenario strings are byte-identical, only re-wrapped by prettier; they still contain no em dashes.

### `dvr-information` — `app/(form)/dvr-information.tsx`

**Status:** CHANGED (retention badge retokened; three cards nested)
**Phase/PR:** `034267c7` fix(dvr-information): paint OVERWRITTEN as the severity it is · `6b1b14ae` close the last two colors.primary-as-body-text sites (F115-3) · `85ccd173` token the DVR retention badge and nest its cards in the glass tier · `d1739700` prettier

**Canonical recipe NOW.**

Status mapping (`:158-176`) — the status→severity half moved OUT to `retention-calculation.ts`:
```ts
const getRetentionStatusDetails = (
  status: RetentionStatus | undefined,
): { accent: string; foreground: string; label: string } => {
  const severity = status && RETENTION_SEVERITY[status]
  if (!severity)
    return { accent: colors.textSecondary, foreground: colors.text, label: 'Unknown' }
  return { accent: colors[severity], foreground: colors[`${severity}OnLight`], label: status }
}
```
`RETENTION_SEVERITY` (`src/lib/utils/retention-calculation.ts:34-39`):
```ts
export const RETENTION_SEVERITY = {
  CRITICAL: 'error',
  WARNING: 'warning',
  SAFE: 'success',
  OVERWRITTEN: 'error',
} as const satisfies Record<RetentionStatus, 'error' | 'warning' | 'success'>
```
Resolved per state — accent (badge tint + border) / foreground (text):
```
CRITICAL     accent #ef4444 light, #ff4757 dark   foreground #991b1b light, #f0f4f8 dark
WARNING      accent #f59e0b light, #ffd93d dark   foreground #78350f light, #f0f4f8 dark
SAFE         accent #10b981 light, #10d177 dark   foreground #065f46 light, #f0f4f8 dark
OVERWRITTEN  accent #ef4444 light, #ff4757 dark   foreground #991b1b light, #f0f4f8 dark
(no status)  accent textSecondary                  foreground colors.text        label 'Unknown'
```
The label is now the raw `status` string, so the four labels are `CRITICAL` / `WARNING` / `SAFE` / `OVERWRITTEN`.

Badge markup (`:425-437`):

Literals for the badge: `padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 4px; border-width: 1px`, text `12px / 600`.

**What it replaced:** a four-branch switch returning ONE colour, used for badge tint, badge border AND text:
```ts
const getRetentionStatusDetails = (status: RetentionStatus | undefined) => {
  if (!status) return { color: colors.textSecondary, label: 'Unknown' }
  switch (status) {
    case 'CRITICAL':    return { color: colors.error, label: 'CRITICAL' }
    case 'WARNING':     return { color: '#f59e0b', label: 'WARNING' }
    case 'SAFE':        return { color: '#10b981', label: 'SAFE' }
    case 'OVERWRITTEN': return { color: colors.textSecondary, label: 'OVERWRITTEN' }
    default:            return { color: colors.textSecondary, label: 'Unknown' }
  }
}
```
Note the two hard literals `'#f59e0b'` and `'#10b981'` — the LIGHT theme's `warning` / `success`, rendered unchanged in dark mode. Badge tint was `backgroundColor: \`${statusDetails.color}20\`` (a hex-alpha string append) with `borderColor: statusDetails.color`. All three cards were plain flat `<Card>`. `retentionTitle` was `colors.primary`.

**Notes / quoted measurements** (in-file `:155-168`): "Two colours per state, following the `Banner` split (**ruling D8a**): the saturated `accent` carries the signal on the badge tint and border, and the measured `*OnLight` foreground carries the text. Colouring the text with the accent — which this did — put the evidence-overwrite warning at **1.95:1 (WARNING)** and **2.25:1 (SAFE)** in light mode." And: "the four-branch switch this replaces had quietly mapped OVERWRITTEN — the terminal state — onto the same neutral pair as the 'Unknown' fallback." `retentionTitle` note quotes **2.81:1 dark**. No user-facing copy changed.

### `SyncStatusCard` — `src/features/precision-time-sync/components/SyncStatusCard.tsx`

**Status:** CHANGED substantially — the campaign rebuilt this surface
**Phase/PR:** `09fb9893` fix(time-sync): paint the traceability chain as a value, not a label (F121-1) · `ecb7a5ff` fix(time-sync): unify SyncStatusCard on nested glass and Ionicons status · `d1739700` prettier

**Role:** The forensic time-calibration readout inside `time-offset.tsx`'s glass FormSection. Two forms: an expanded card and a one-line compact card.

**Canonical recipe NOW.**

Divider constant (`SyncStatusCard.tsx:22-28`):
```ts
// The header/body rule and the traceability rule. `colors.border` is the
// obvious token and is the wrong one here: on the nested-glass surface this
// card now paints it measures 1.24:1 (dark) and 1.02:1 (light) - the light
// value is literally the surface colour, which is the same disappearing act
// the black-alpha rules it replaces were guilty of. A foreground-derived
// hairline is the only recipe that survives both schemes (1.72:1 / 1.51:1).
const DIVIDER_ALPHA = 0.2
```
Both rules paint `withAlpha(colors.text, 0.2)` → `rgba(17,24,39,0.2)` light / `rgba(240,244,248,0.2)` dark.

Status map (`:127-157`) — Ionicons, colour reaching the ICON ONLY:
```ts
isSyncing        → { color: colors.textSecondary, icon: 'hourglass-outline',  text: 'Synchronizing...' }
error/!success   → { color: colors.error,         icon: 'alert-circle',       text: 'Sync Failed' }
success          → { color: colors.success,       icon: 'checkmark-circle',   text: 'Synchronized' }
otherwise        → { color: colors.textSecondary, icon: 'ellipse-outline',    text: 'Not Synchronized' }
```

Compact form (`:163-213`) — rendered when `isExpanded === false && syncResult?.success && !isSyncing`:
```tsx
<View style={style}>
  <Pressable onPress={onToggleExpanded} testID={`${testID}-compact`}>
    <Card glass glassVariant="nestedCard" style={styles.compactCard} testID={testID}>
      <View style={styles.compactContent}>
        <Text style={[styles.compactLabel, { color: colors.textSecondary }]}>Offset: </Text>
        <Text style={[styles.compactValue, { color: colors.text }]}>
          {offsetInfo?.text} ({offsetInfo?.direction})
        </Text>
        <Text style={[styles.compactDivider, { color: colors.textSecondary }]}>{' | '}</Text>
        {isForensicMode ? (
          <>
            <Ionicons name="checkmark-circle" size={Layout.iconSize.xs} color={colors.success}
              style={styles.compactIcon} accessibilityElementsHidden importantForAccessibility="no" />
            <Text style={[styles.compactValue, { color: colors.text }]}>Used for calculation</Text>
          </>
        ) : (
          <>
            <Text style={[styles.compactLabel, { color: colors.textSecondary }]}>Synced: </Text>
            <Text style={[styles.compactValue, { color: colors.text }]}>
              {lastSyncTimestamp ? formatAbsoluteTime(lastSyncTimestamp) : 'N/A'}
            </Text>
          </>
        )}
        <Ionicons name="chevron-down" size={Layout.iconSize.xs} color={colors.textSecondary}
          style={styles.compactChevron} accessibilityElementsHidden importantForAccessibility="no" />
      </View>
    </Card>
  </Pressable>
</View>
```

Expanded form (`:215-350`):
```tsx
<Card glass glassVariant="nestedCard" style={styles.card} testID={testID} techGlow={syncResult?.success}>
  <View style={styles.header}>
    <Ionicons name="time-outline" size={Layout.iconSize.sm} color={colors.text}
      accessibilityElementsHidden importantForAccessibility="no" />
    <Text style={[styles.title, { color: colors.text }]}>Time Calibration</Text>
  </View>

  <View style={[styles.divider, { backgroundColor: withAlpha(colors.text, DIVIDER_ALPHA) }]} />

  <View style={styles.content}>
    {/* Status row: label `colors.textSecondary`; ActivityIndicator (colors.primary) while
        syncing, else the Ionicon in statusInfo.color; the WORD is always colors.text */}
    {/* Error row: alert-circle in colors.error + errorText in colors.text */}
    {/* Method / Server / Device Offset / Uncertainty / Network Delay / Last Sync|Calibrated at */}
    <View style={[styles.traceabilitySection, { borderTopColor: withAlpha(colors.text, DIVIDER_ALPHA) }]}>
      <Text style={[styles.traceabilityLabel, { color: colors.textSecondary }]}>Traceable to:</Text>
      <Text style={[styles.traceabilityText, { color: colors.text }]}>{getTraceabilityChain()}</Text>
    </View>
  </View>
</Card>
```
Row labels (`Status:`, `Method:`, `Server:`, `Device Offset:`, `Uncertainty:`, `Network Delay:`, `Last Sync:` / `Calibrated at:`) all `colors.textSecondary`; every VALUE `colors.text`. Values: method `'NTP (Atomic Clock)'` / `'HTTP API'`; offset `${(|offset|/1000).toFixed(3)}s` + `(slow|fast|synchronized)`; uncertainty `±{Number(uncertainty.toFixed(2))}ms`; network delay `{(rtt/2).toFixed(2)}ms`; times via `toLocaleTimeString('en-GB', { hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit', second:'2-digit', hour12:false })`.

```ts
    paddingTop: Layout.spacing.sm,
    borderTopWidth: 1,
    // borderTopColor applied inline: withAlpha(colors.text, DIVIDER_ALPHA)
  },
  traceabilityLabel: {
    fontSize: Typography.fontSize.xs,
    fontWeight: Typography.fontWeight.medium,
    marginBottom: Layout.spacing.xs,
  },
  traceabilityText: {
    fontSize: Typography.fontSize.xs,
    fontStyle: 'italic',
    lineHeight: Typography.fontSize.xs * Typography.lineHeight.normal,
  },
  compactCard: { marginBottom: Layout.spacing.md },
  compactContent: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    flexWrap: 'wrap',
  },
  compactLabel: { fontSize: Typography.fontSize.sm },
  compactValue: { fontSize: Typography.fontSize.sm, fontWeight: Typography.fontWeight.semibold },
  compactDivider: { fontSize: Typography.fontSize.sm },
  compactIcon: { marginRight: Layout.spacing.xxs },
  compactChevron: { marginLeft: Layout.spacing.xs },
})
```
Literals: title `18px / 700`; divider `1px`, `margin-bottom: 16px`; rows `min-height: 24px`, label/value split `40% / 60%` with the value right-aligned; content `gap: 8px`; traceability text `12px italic, line-height 18px`; compact row wraps and centres.

**What it replaced** (`git show d9606460:…/SyncStatusCard.tsx`) — concretely:
- **Flat cards.** `<Card style={styles.card} testID={testID} techGlow={syncResult?.success}>` and `<Card style={styles.compactCard} testID={testID}>` — no `glass`, no variant. This card was, in its own words (`:60-61`), "the one flat box between two gradients."
- **Colour emoji instead of Ionicons.** `getStatusInfo` returned `icon: '⏳'` / `'❌'` / `'✓'` / (idle) — rendered as `<Text style={[styles.statusIcon, { color: statusInfo.color }]}>` with `statusIcon: { fontSize: Typography.fontSize.lg }`. Header title was the string `'⏱️ Time Calibration'`.
- **Status word painted with the severity.** `<Text style={[styles.statusText, { color: statusInfo.color }]}>`; error row text `colors.error`.
- **`colors.primary` on two values:** compact offset value (`colors.primary`) and expanded `offsetValue` (`colors.primary`). Compact "Used for calculation" was `colors.success`. Compact chevron was a `<Text>` glyph.
- **Traceability chain in `colors.textSecondary`.**
- **Black-alpha rules:** `divider: { backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)' }` and `traceabilitySection: { borderTopColor: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05)' }` baked into the StyleSheet.

**Notes / quoted measurements:**
- Docblock `:54-58`: "Status is carried by an Ionicon, colour-coded for quick recognition (green synchronized / red failed / grey idle or syncing). The WORDS beside it are always `colors.text`: the saturated status tokens measure **2.1-3.2:1** as body text on this card, and the icon is free to carry the colour because the label carries the meaning."
- `:119-126`: "`colors.error` at 16px semibold measures **3.51:1 (dark) / 3.76:1 (light)** — below AA, on the line that tells the operator their forensic clock did not calibrate. The glyphs were colour emoji (⏳ ❌), which ignore the `color` style on both platforms, so the computed colour was a silent no-op there as well and a screen reader announced the emoji instead of a status."
- `DIVIDER_ALPHA` note: `colors.border` would measure **1.24:1 dark / 1.02:1 light** here; the foreground-derived hairline measures **1.72:1 / 1.51:1**.
- **F121-1** at `:338-341`: the traceability chain "is the national-metrology provenance of a court-facing calibration, so it takes `colors.text` like every other value on this card (**14.55:1 light / 9.56:1 dark**)."
- Every decorative icon carries `accessibilityElementsHidden` + `importantForAccessibility="no"`.
- **No user-facing copy changed** other than dropping the ⏱️ from the header title ("⏱️ Time Calibration" → "Time Calibration").

### Ruling D6(a) — `ForceColorScheme`

**No file in this scope uses it.** `grep -rn ForceColorScheme src/ --include=*.ts{,x}` (excluding `__tests__`) returns exactly five non-test consumers, none of them mine:

- `src/context/ThemeContext.tsx:114-130` — the component itself (`interface ForceColorSchemeProps` / `export function ForceColorScheme({ scheme, children })`).

The two PDF preview modals in my scope solve the same "always dark" problem **without** `ForceColorScheme`: they read `Colors.dark.*` directly for the loading overlay (see those two entries).

### Ruling D7(a) — `onPrimary` / `onError`

**No file in my scope consumes `colors.onPrimary` or `colors.onError` directly.** The only mention is `PasswordModal.tsx:244`, inside a comment explaining why that call site deliberately uses `colors.textInverse` **instead** of `onPrimary`. **Status:** CHANGED (one rendered value)
**Phase/PR:** `cdcb239c fix(settings): converge the SettingsModal and PasswordModal scrims on colors.scrim`; `a6fc97fc fix(settings): contain async rejections at void-callback boundaries`; `d1739700 style: adopt prettier and reformat (886 files)`

**Role:** The iOS-style master/detail navigator inside a native `pageSheet` — category list pushes a detail pane in from the right, with an interactive right-swipe pop.

**Canonical recipe NOW:**

- Modal: `visible`, `animationType="slide"`, `presentationStyle="pageSheet"`, `onRequestClose={handleRequestClose}` (`:131-136`).
- Root `SafeAreaView` `{ backgroundColor: colors.background }` (`:137`), wrapping `<GridBackground showScanLine={false}>` (`:138`).
- **Scrim over the master pane while detail is open — `:61`:**
  ```ts
  const scrimColor = colors.scrim   // light rgba(0,0,0,0.5) / dark rgba(0,40,83,0.32)
  ```
  Painted as `[StyleSheet.absoluteFill, { backgroundColor: scrimColor }, scrimStyle]`, `pointerEvents={activeId ? 'auto' : 'none'}` (`:153-156`); `scrimStyle` interpolates `opacity` `[0,1] → [0,1]` (`:124-126`).
- Detail pane `{ backgroundColor: colors.background }` (`:166`).
- Animation constants (`:41-42`): `ENTER = { duration: 320, easing: Easing.out(Easing.cubic) }`, `EXIT = { duration: 280, easing: Easing.out(Easing.cubic) }`.
- Master parallax (`:115-118`): `translateX` interpolate `[0,1] → [0, -paneW * 0.25]`, `opacity` `[0,1] → [1, 0.55]`.
- Detail push (`:120-122`): `translateX` interpolate `[0,1] → [paneW, 0]`.
- Pan gesture (`:96-113`): `.activeOffsetX(16)`, `.failOffsetY([-14, 14])`; dismiss when `translationX > paneW * 0.32 || velocityX > 650`.

```ts
const styles = StyleSheet.create({            // :194-216
  container: { flex: 1 },
  stage: { flex: 1, overflow: 'hidden' },
  pane: { ...StyleSheet.absoluteFillObject, flexDirection: 'column' },
  detailPane: {

  },
  detailScroll: { flex: 1 },
  detailContent: {
    padding: Layout.spacing.lg,          // 24
    paddingBottom: Layout.spacing.xxl,   // 48
  },
})
```

**What it replaced:** `d9606460` line 58 had a hand-rolled fork:
```ts
const scrimColor = colorScheme === 'dark' ? 'rgba(2, 8, 18, 0.5)' : 'rgba(17, 24, 39, 0.06)'
```
Everything else is byte-identical (prettier line-wrapping + `void openCategory(category)` containment).

**Notes:** In-file comment at `:58-60`: "One of five ad-hoc scrim recipes the app shipped. The dark value was a near-black derived from the PRE-recolor navy, and the light value dimmed at 0.06 alpha, which is barely a tint." Light scrim therefore goes from **0.06 → 0.50 alpha** — a big visible darkening; dark goes from near-black 0.5 to navy 0.32 (lighter, and navy-tinted).

**Status:** CHANGED

**Role:** The Settings master pane — grouped, inset glass cards of category rows plus an app-name/version footer.

**Canonical recipe NOW:** Each group is `<Text style={sectionLabel}>` + `<Card glass style={styles.card}>` holding `SettingsCategoryRow`s (`:44-64`). `Card glass` with no `glassVariant` = `GlassColors[scheme].card` at `borderRadius.lg (12)`, `borderWidth: 1`, plus `Layout.shadow.card[scheme]` and a 1px `highlightTop` absolute edge (see `Card.tsx:165-192`). `style={{ padding: 0 }}` is routed to the gradient (Card's padding-routing), not stacked.

```ts
const styles = StyleSheet.create({                 // :73-99
  scroll: { flex: 1 },
  content: { padding: Layout.spacing.md, paddingBottom: Layout.spacing.xxl },   // 16 / 48
  section: { marginBottom: Layout.spacing.lg },                                 // 24
```

Colors: `sectionLabel` → `colors.textSecondary` (`:46`); footer → `colors.textTertiary` (`:66`), content `` `${appName} · v${version}` `` where the defaults are `'DVR Extraction Notes'` / `'1.0.0'` (`:35-36`).

**What it replaced:** a hand-rolled `LinearGradient` reading `GlassColors[scheme].card` with local styles `{ borderRadius: Layout.borderRadius.xl /* 16 */, borderWidth: 1, overflow: 'hidden' }` and `borderColor: glass.border`. **Two rendered deltas:** the group card radius drops **16 → 12** (Card's `lg`), it gains `Layout.shadow.card` and the 1px `highlightTop` edge; and `sectionLabel.fontSize` goes **`Typography.fontSize.xs + 0.5` (12.5) → 12**.

**Notes:** `:47-52` comment explains `padding: 0` — "the rows are edge-to-edge: each one paints its own pressed background across the full width and hangs a separator off its bottom edge. `Card` routes a caller's padding to the gradient… so this overrides its default `md` rather than stacking on it (the double-padding Phase 0 fixed)."

```ts
    // onto its outer wrapper, whose only in-flow child is the gradient, so it
    // would be inert there (DEF-UI-013). Carried on the child instead.
    marginTop: Layout.spacing.xs,   // 4
  },
  bannerWithAction: { gap: Layout.spacing.sm },   // 8
})
```

**What it replaced:**
- `statusBox: { gap: Layout.spacing.xs, padding: Layout.spacing.md, borderWidth: 1, borderRadius: Layout.borderRadius.md }` with `borderColor: colors.border` → now the `nestedCard` glass Card (radius 12, glass gradient, `Layout.shadow.card`, highlight edge, padding `md` 16 from Card's default).
- Three copies of `infoBox: { gap: Layout.spacing.sm, padding: Layout.spacing.md, borderRadius: Layout.borderRadius.md, borderWidth: 1 }` + `infoText: { fontSize: sm, lineHeight: sm*1.5 }`, each filled `colors.warningBackground` or `colors.infoLight` with a 16px `colors.warning`/`colors.info` icon and text in the **same saturated accent** → all now `Banner`.
- `errorText: { fontSize: Typography.fontSize.sm, textAlign: 'center' }` in `colors.error` → `Banner severity="error"`.

**Notes:** `:153-159` comment: the status box is deliberately **not** a Banner — "'Connected' is a neutral state surface with two lines and no severity… Plan section 1 routes outline-only surfaces to `nestedCard`… its only boundary was `colors.border`, measuring **1.73:1** against `colors.background` in dark, under WCAG 1.4.11's 3:1 for a sole visual boundary." `:186-188`: "The action is a SIBLING of the Banner, not a child: a Banner is a status line, not a layout slot. Same shape as MapPicker's error row." DEF-UI-013 cited at `:342-344`.

**Phase/PR:** `25862c77 perf(icons)`; `ad62ecb2`; `069e0faa`; `fe426966 fix(settings): label the two primary Buttons with Button's own recipe, not onPrimary`; `5d3a5de0 refactor(export-security): move PasswordModal onto Checkbox, Button and theme tokens`; `20e14b79`; `38d41d5e feat(design-system): add Layout.shadow.dialog for centred modal cards (F2)`; `cdcb239c fix(settings): converge the SettingsModal and PasswordModal scrims on colors.scrim`; `d1739700` prettier

**Role:** The centred, glass, export-time encryption-password dialog: password field with show/hide, "save as default" checkbox, unrecoverable warning, Cancel/Export.

### **Shadow — the answer: `Layout.shadow.dialog[colorScheme]`, NOT `sheet`.**
`PasswordModal.tsx:107-124`:
```tsx
<LinearGradient
  colors={[...glassColors.gradient]}
  style={[
    styles.glassContainer,
    { borderColor: glassColors.border },
    // `Layout.shadow.dialog` rather than a local `#000` recipe: a
    // neutral black shadow disappears against a white light-mode
    // background, which is why the token's light half is navy
    // tinted. It also bundles Android's elevation, so the
    // Platform.select this replaces is redundant.
    //
    // `dialog`, not `sheet`: this overlay is
    // `justifyContent: 'center'`, so the card floats in the middle of
    // the screen. `sheet` casts upward by design because a bottom
    // sheet rises from the bottom edge, which put the glow above the
    // card here.
    Layout.shadow.dialog[colorScheme],
  ]}
>
```
Resolved: **light** `shadowColor 'rgba(30, 58, 138, 0.15)'`, `offset {0, 8}`, `opacity 1`, `radius 28`, `elevation 24`; **dark** `shadowColor '#000'`, `offset {0, 8}`, `opacity 0.5`, `radius 40`, `elevation 24`.

**Canonical recipe NOW:**

- `glassColors = GlassColors[colorScheme].elevated` (`:43`).
- Backdrop `Pressable testID="password-modal-backdrop"` `[styles.overlay, { backgroundColor: colors.scrim }]` (`:96-99`) — light `rgba(0,0,0,0.5)`, dark `rgba(0,40,83,0.32)`.
- Card = `LinearGradient` with the `elevated` gradient + `borderColor: glassColors.border` + `dialog` shadow; 1px top highlight `View` `{ backgroundColor: glassColors.highlightTop }` (`:127`).
- Header (`:130-143`): title `colors.text`, close `Pressable` `hitSlop={10}` with `Ionicons name="close" size={18} color={colors.textSecondary}`, `opacity: pressed ? 0.6 : 1`.
- Divider (`:146-151`): `LinearGradient colors={['transparent', withAlpha(colors.primary, 0.3), 'transparent']}` horizontal (`start {0,0.5}` → `end {1,0.5}`), `height: 1`.
- Input (`:158-188`): container `{ borderColor: colors.border }`; `TextInput { color: colors.text }`, placeholder `"Minimum 8 characters"` in `colors.textTertiary`, `returnKeyType="done"`; eye `hitSlop={10}`, glyph 20px `colors.textSecondary`.
- Validation hint (`:191-198`): `colors.textTertiary`, text `"Minimum 8 characters"`.
- Checkbox (`:202-207`): shared `<Checkbox testID="password-modal-save-default" value onValueChange label="Save as default password" />` → 24×24 box, `borderWidth: 2`, `borderRadius: Layout.borderRadius.sm (4)`, filled `colors.primary` when checked with a `✓` in `colors.onPrimary` at 16px/700, label 16px `colors.text`, container `paddingVertical: 8`, `minHeight: 44`, pressed `opacity: 0.7`, haptics.
- Warning (`:210-215`): `<Banner testID="password-modal-warning" severity="warning" style={styles.warningBanner} message="Password cannot be recovered. If you forget the password, the encrypted file cannot be opened." />`
- Buttons (`:218-259`): Cancel `<Button variant="secondary" size="small" style={styles.rowButton}>`; Export `<Button variant="primary" size="small" style={styles.rowButton} disabled={!isPasswordValid}>` wrapping

  ```tsx
    <Text style={[styles.exportButtonText, { color: colors.textInverse }]}>Export</Text>
  </View>
  ```
